en: Found lying by the side of the road
zh: 从路边捡来的

en: Take Data
zh: 取走数据

en: Terrain
zh: 地形

en: Biome
zh: 生态群系

en: Why go up when you can crash equally well going sideways – that’s the old moto of the C7 Aerospace Division. Emerging from humble beginnings to the powerhouse they are now, C7 were always looking straight ahead towards the horizon. Recently though they have been building parts that can give them a much better view of that spot where the sky meets the ground. This has been met with some grumblings from the old boys in the company but even they can’t deny that there is adventure to be found in whatever direction you choose.
zh: “既然横着飞也能飘逸地坠毁，那还往上飞什么呢” - 这是C7航天部门之前的座右铭。C7的初创时期十分艰辛，不过现在已经发展成为了强大的组织，他们向来目光只放在地平线。但是最近他们却在建造一些部件，这些部件能够帮助他们更好地欣赏天地一线的美景。公司中的老伙计们对这件事颇有微词，但就算是他们也不得不承认：无论选择什么方向，那里总会有奇遇在等着你。

en: Dinkelstein Kerman has become somewhat of a legend in the spacecraft industry, not least impressively because he vehemently claims to have been constructing and flying spaceships long before the first actual recorded instance of any such vehicle being assembled. This has led to some controversy and a lot of awkwardness between him and the Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society. Be that as it may, Dinklestein's Emporium is still generally well regarded as a traditional, old-fashioned company, and their products are actually a lot less rusty than the company's owner.
zh: Dinkelstein Kerman之所以能够成为航天业的传奇，主要并不是因为他坚称自己在第一艘有记载能够飞行的航天器问世前，就已经成功完成了此类载具的组装与试航。这件事导致他和Kerbin世界第一纪录保持协会之间颇有些争执。但尽管如此，Dinkelstein建材商城仍然是一家公认的传统公司，其产品也比公司所有者要可靠得多。

en: The Experimental Engineering Group is a typical startup company: Low budgets and impossibly tight deadlines are part of a normal working day for them. Despite being such a young company however, Experimental Engineering has made a good start, quickly making a name for themselves in the industry, mainly thanks to their very educational and entertaining SC-9001 Science Jr. Experiment Kit. Despite valiant efforts from their representatives, however, they haven't quite been able to shake off the bad press that followed some leaked footage of an incident involving one of their units and a small critter that one of the scientists over at R&D used to keep as a pet. Some say the incident has made them extremely concerned with the safety of anything that approach their products. They've even rounded out the edges on their company logo.
zh: 实验工程集团是一家典型的初创公司：低预算和不可能达成的死线是他们日常工作的一部分。尽管公司刚建立不久，但起步十分成功，很快就在行业内建立起了声望，这主要归功于他们极具教育意义和娱乐性的SC-9001小型科学实验室。然而，在他们的产品和研发中心的一名科学家养的宠物小牛之间发生的事故录像不慎泄露后，公司的发言人尽了极大努力，还是未能完全扭转此事带来的负面舆论。有人说这起事故让他们对任何接近其产品的物体的安全都极度担忧，以至于他们还把公司的标志都改成了圆角的。

en: FLOOYD Labs is a company focused on doing one thing, and doing it as well as is conceivably possible to do it: Displacing liquids from one place to another. Their flagship product, the FTX-2 Fuel Duct, is the final result of years of research and development and endless Kerbal-hours of effort to produce a device that will pump any amount of just about anything, no matter how cold, dense or volatile it is. The company enjoys a well-deserved reputation for such an important contribution to the industry, and most agree that these days, almost nobody remembers the embarrassment of their recall of the FTX-1 series, which had a small but highly problematic issue, that while it did pump fluids flawlessly, it pumped them in the wrong direction.
zh: 弗拉伊德实验室只做一件事，并且要将这件事做到比想像中的水平还要高，那就是将液体从一个位置转移到另一个位置。他们的旗舰产品——FTX-2燃料管道，是他们多年研发的结晶。在无数个小时的努力后，他们终于造出了一种能将任何东西泵出来的产品，无论那东西有多凉、多浓稠或是多不稳定。公司凭借对行业的重大贡献享誉世界，大部分人都同意，近些年几乎不会再有人记起当初他们召回FTX-1系列的尴尬了。该系列存在一个虽然微小但会带来很大麻烦的问题，就是尽管产品能够顺畅泵压液体，但方向却是错的。

en: Goliath National Products know what’s needed to keep them ahead of the competition – an eye for detail and a good nose for sniffing out what’s needed for our plucky engineers. Many of the great Vessels of our age carry one of Goliaths nose cones and they excel in moving air out of the way of the soft fleshy important bits of any Vessel i.e. our heroes heading off on another adventure.
zh: 歌利亚国家制造厂深切地知道究竟需要什么才能保证自己的领先地位 - 只需一双注重细节的眼睛，以及一只能够嗅出那些勇敢工程师需求的灵敏鼻子。我们所处的时代诞生了许多伟大的航空器，其中有不少都装备有出自歌利亚的头锥。这让所有航空器都能突破空气阻力，以保护其它脆弱的重要部位，比如我们那些勇敢踏上新征程的英雄们。

en: What this small company lacks in experience and reputation, it makes up for in the sheer ambitiousness of their projects. Their first product was the very massive Mobile Processing Lab, which rumour has it was first developed as a mobile processing facility to secretly brew an experimental, possibly illegal fuel mixture, which was reportedly far more potent than the currently available propellants, and had a distinctive blue tint to it. Those rumours have never been proven however, and this mysterious blue propellant has yet to be seen by a reliable source. Despite their repeated attempts to be rid of these rumours, the company still suffers from a (probably undeserved) bad reputation. They try to offset this initial impression by offering much larger cash payoffs than other companies of similar size, which admittedly does very little to improve their current image.
zh: 这家小公司虽然缺乏经验和声望，但其项目的勃勃野心弥补了这些短处。他们的第一个产品是超大型移动处理实验室，据传研发这款移动处理设备的初衷是用于秘密合成某种试验性质的、有可能是违法的混合燃料，有报告称该燃料比当前市面上的燃料动力更强劲，并且呈现出一种独特的蓝色。但是谣言从未被证实，也没有任何可靠的信息源声明曾经见过这种神秘的蓝色燃料。尽管该公司多次尝试消灭谣言，但仍然声名狼藉（也许是被冤枉的）。他们试图通过比其他相同规模的公司接受更大金额的现金支付来抵消负面的第一印象，然而这对改变其现有状况收效甚微。

en: One of the leading names in spacecraft electronics, and not just because the name itself sounds so cool. Ionic Symphonic Protonic Electronics has a large catalogue of components, ranging from simple comms devices to seriously cutting edge gear. This has made their products quite popular among aerospace engineers, and also nurtured a profound enmity from the pragmatic folks at Probodobodyne.
zh: 太空电子领域的知名企业之一，而且这并不完全是因为他们的名字十分炫酷。离子质子电子交响乐的产品种类繁多，从简单的通用设备到领先的尖端设备。因此他们的产品在宇宙工程师之中颇为流行，同时引起了探测动力公司那帮务实的家伙深深的敌意。

en: It is universally agreed that Jeb's Junkyard is one the best examples of the triumph of unwavering motivation in the face of seemingly insurmountable odds. The unassuming junkyard where it is said some of Kerbalkind's first steps towards the depths of space have been taken, has now become a much larger junkyard, as it had to expand its facilities to accommodate the ever greater demand for spacecraft components. Jeb's Junkyard has become one of Kerbin's most iconic names, becoming far more than just a beloved brand. It now stands proudly as a symbol of the unstoppable Kerbal drive towards attempting the impossible while grossly underestimating the gravity of the situation.
zh: Jeb的废品回收公司是不屈不挠、起死回生的最佳案例之一，这一点已经成为共识。过去那个不起眼的废品回收场曾是坎巴拉人飞向太空深处的起点之一，如今在不断增长的航天器组件需求下，规模已经大大扩张。Jebediah的废品回收已成为Kerbin最具标志性的品牌之一，而不仅仅是一个流行品牌。现在，他们成为了一个骄傲的象征，代表坎巴拉人即使误判形势，仍旧勇往直前克服万难的决心。

en: Kerbal Motion LLC started in the wheel business with square wheels initially. They began adding sides until they settled on a more spherical configuration. Intensive testing confirmed their suspicions that round wheels really do make for a much smoother ride. Once they had overcome this hurdle the brains at Kerbal Motion LLC then began looking towards what else they could apply their considerable grey matter to. They settled on grabbers, primarily as this would mean they wouldn’t have to reach quite so far for their drinks.
zh: 坎巴拉运动有限公司最初凭借四条边的方形轮胎打入了轮胎行业。后来他们开始添加更多边，直到做出了接近圆形的轮胎。在经过了大量的测试工作后，他们总算证明了自己的猜想：圆形轮胎确实能让乘坐体验更加舒适。在攻克了这一难关后，坎巴拉运动有限公司的聪明人们开始琢磨能不能在其它地方也用上自己的“聪明才智”。于是他们研究起了抓取器，当然其最初的想法只是让自己不需要伸长手去够饮料罢了。

en: An institution completely devoted to the tracking and curating all first instances of any event, the Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society is a  non-profit organization, for the purpose of rewarding the doing of anything that's never been done before, especially concerning feats of space exploration. Their work is more challenging than it would seem however, as the prestige associated with the first-ever accomplishment of any deed is also a valuable target for commercial companies, who wouldn't waste the opportunity to be the official sponsor of such an event. Taking on the Society's contracts will definitely send the message that you're not in it for the money, which is always a good message to send. It's also just about the only reward, since the cash prizes are mostly symbolic.
zh: Kerbin世界第一纪录保持协会是一家非营利组织，始终致力于记录和整理任何第一次发生的事件，和旨在奖励完成任意一件从未被完成的事情的人，尤其是与太空探索有关的事绩方面。然而，他们的工作难度其实比看上去要高得多，因为第一次完成某件事在商业公司眼中也是颇具价值的目标，他们不会放过赞助此类事项的机会。与协会签约会明确表示你并非是为钱而来，这样的姿态通常会为人称道。当然，这也几乎是仅有的奖励了，因为奖金基本是象征性的。

en: Although Kerbodyne is a relatively new name in the aerospace industry, their K series engines and fuel tanks have earned them a quite a reputation in a short amount of time. So much so in fact, that Kerbodyne was nominated for the "Best Debut" Award, at last year's Spacecraft Developers Convention. Unfortunately, that prize went to another company, but Kerbodyne fans are known to demonstrate loudly and publicly, their appreciation for the company and its products.
zh: 尽管坎巴拉动力在航空业是一家相对年轻的企业，他们的K系列引擎和燃料箱在很短时间内就赢得了相当高的名望。事实上，坎巴拉动力在去年的太空飞船研发者大会获得了“最佳亮相”奖的提名。不幸的是，奖项花落别家，但坎巴拉动力的支持者仍然以公开表示他们对公司和其产品的热爱而闻名。

en: Kerlington has a long history of introducing ground-breaking new technologies, many of which are now considered indispensable for rocketry and aerospace engineering. This has fostered a strong community of loyal Kerlington fans, as well as a similarly large group of disgruntled competitors.
zh: 坎灵顿有着悠久的研发突破性信息技术的传统，其中很多都被认为是火箭学和航空工程学不可或缺的成果。因此坎灵顿拥有一大批忠实的追随者，以及差不多一样多的心怀不满的竞争者。

en: The Maxo Construction Toys engineers always enjoyed building things – especially out of little plastic bricks. So when they put their heads together and got a bit of money in the bank they decided to do the same but with bits of lightweight metal. Maxo’s metallic constructions are renowned for their durability and build quality. In fact when sifting through the wreckage of yet another spectacular “landing”, their parts are almost always found intact.
zh: 马科索建筑玩具的工程师们一直喜欢进行建造工作 - 尤其喜欢使用小小的塑料砖块。所以他们开了个会，决定用银行里的一点钱购买轻质金属来做同样的事。马科索的金属构件以其持久性与建造质量而闻名。实际上，在又一次壮观美丽的“着陆”完成后，大家总能从废墟中找到完整的马科索构件。

en: The Moving Parts Experts Group started off as a mostly non-commercial initiative to bring some of the brightest minds together to create truly innovative and ground-breaking technologies for spacecraft construction. As is the case with many such enterprises, their initial investment funds very soon ran out and they were forced to start developing stuff that they could sell, quickly. As a result, the Group acquired a reputation for being always in a hurry, and always strapped for cash. They still try their best to stay true to their original motivations as much as possible though, and will always be willing to support any ventures that push the currently established boundaries.
zh: 运动部件专家小组最开始是个几乎非商业的组织，其初衷是将一群最聪明的人才聚集在一起，为太空飞船建造发明真正创新和具有突破性的技术。和其他很多企业的情况一样，他们的初始启动资金很快就用完了，因此被迫开始研发能够迅速卖出去的东西。其后果就是该组织获得了永远在赶进度，而且总是缺钱的名声。他们仍尽可能不忘初心，也会一直乐于进行任何推动最前沿科技的冒险。

en: For a company that made a reputation by creating as much destruction as possible, O.M.B. has found a remarkably suitable place for its highly volatile devices in the aerospace industry. Their precision Decouplers are second to none when the job calls for splitting spacecraft into multiple smaller ones. Some of their other demolition products however, despite being heavily advertised as far more powerful disassembly tools, weren't nearly as successful. O.M.B. is still unsure as to why those "clearly better" products weren't so well received.
zh: 作为一家以尽可能多制造破坏而闻名的公司，O.M.B在航天工业中为其极度不稳定的产品找到了非常理想的位置。他们的精确分离器是将航天器分成多个更小的部分的最佳选择。然而他们的一些其他爆破产品，尽管在广告中被宣传是更强大的分离工具，却远没有前者成功。O.M.B.至今为止也不明白为什么那些“明显更好”的产品会反响不佳。

en: Periapsis Rocket Supplies are a notoriously private company – the small roster of components they do build does nothing but add to the mystique surrounding them. Many question why they don’t build more parts but Periapsis responds to this by stating “wait and see what we’ll do next!”. However, this has been the standard response for at least 3 generations so many have been waiting a little while for the answer.
zh: 近点火箭供应公司是一间极其私密的公司 - 他们所提供的少量组件几乎没有太大作为，这反倒是增添了围绕这间公司的神秘色彩。许多人都在问他们为什么不多做一些部件，但是近点公司的人总是回应说：“敬请期待我们接下来的产品！”。他们在过去的三代中一直在重复这句话，所以许多人可以说是等得花儿都谢了。

en: Probodobodyne was at one point one of the leading (and few) names in the industry. Over the years though, the company has fallen behind the times somewhat, but they continue to maintain their philosophy that space exploration should be the privilege of the few who can overcome the challenges of conquering it, with minimal technological assistance. Their products reflect that pragmatic and arguably obsolete outlook, even in spite of the many newer companies that are coming up around them with alternatives that make space travel far more accessible than it was back in the "early days". Despite all this, the company has retained a small but loyal following of hardcore fans, who live by their vision of a very selective industry, populated only by the very best astronauts and engineers.
zh: 探测动力曾经是本行业龙头之一（虽然本来也没几家）。但随着时间的推移，这家公司有些落后了，但仍然保持着他们原有的哲学观，认为太空探索应该是少数人的特权，这些人应当能够在最低限度的技术支持下克服征服太空带来的挑战。就算在他们的周围，很多新公司都纷纷开始生产将太空旅行变得比“当年”更普及的替代产品，他们的产品仍充分反映出一种务实和看似老朽的风格。尽管如此，这家公司仍然有一批忠实的死忠追随者，尽管人数不多，但他们都认同这个行业的门槛应该很高，只有最好的宇航员和工程师才有资格进入。

en: The Space Program's own Research & Development Department. Headed by celebrity rocket scientist Wernher von Kerman, these guys are the brains of the whole operation. Driven by an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, no piece of data is too small or too irrelevant, and increasing the accumulated knowledge of Kerbalkind is their main motivation. Our resident geniuses only ask to be given due academic credit for their contributions to science, and that all astronauts PLEASE refrain from entering the labs without cleaning their boots first.
zh: 太空计划的自有研发部门。该部门由知名火箭科学家Wernher von Kerman带领，是整个项目的智囊。在对知识无止境的渴求面前，没有任何数据是无关紧要的，他们最大的动力就是扩展坎巴拉人的共有知识。我们的常驻天才们仅仅要求他们对科学的贡献能在学界获得应有的尊重，以及所有宇航员在进入实验室之前一定要把靴子清理干净。

en: Reaction Systems is a small company, which enjoyed a reasonable amount of success with their one successful product, the Place-Anywhere Linear RCS Port. These days, nobody knows for certain what they're working on. Even though Reaction Systems is most definitely not the largest company out there, they try to make up for it by supporting all pioneering endeavours. Also, their eagerness to offer science-gathering contracts lends credit to speculation that they may be up to something.
zh: 反应系统是一家小公司，他们凭借一款出色的产品，“随便放”线性RCS喷口，品尝到了成功的滋味。最近一段时间，没人知道他们在做什么。尽管反应系统绝不是最大的公司，但他们支持所有先驱者们的尝试，试图迎头赶上，而且他们对科学点数收集合约的迫切态度也让人们更加相信背后一定有什么交易。

en: Indisputably the largest supplier of rocketry components out there, Rockomax products are widely regarded as the most accessible way to get into space. This has earned them a somewhat negative reputation among the more posh or avant-garde engineers, some even outright refusing to admit to having used Rockomax-Brand products. Be that as it may, Rockomax's gigantic presence in the industry cannot be gainsaid, and their products are actually pretty good value, even if they do lack that 'trendy' feel of the more up-scale rocketry brands. They are a massively large corporation, so don't expect them to cut you very special deals. They are already giving all their customers a bulk discount, plus their 'super-value' deals when using products from their partner brands. All this provided, of course, that you have your membership card with you when you go shopping at their warehouses.
zh: 极限火箭是最大的火箭组件供应商，这一点应该毫无争议。他们的产品被认为是进入太空所需的，门槛最低的工具，不过这就让他们在比较前卫的工程师群体里名声不太好，有些人甚至完全不承认曾经使用过极限火箭的任何产品。尽管如此，极限火箭的行业巨头地位不容置疑，他们的产品质量也确实不错，虽然他们确实不太有那些高级火箭品牌的“时尚”感。这是一家规模庞大的公司，所以别指望他们给你什么特殊折扣。他们已经为全体客户提供巨大的折扣，以及在你使用竞争对手产品时的“超值”交易。当然，以上一切的前提都是当你去他们的库房采购时，没忘记带上会员卡。

en: Rokea is mainly known for their 'vertical mobility enhancer' products, which they go to great lengths to ensure are not mistaken by simplistic 'ladders'. Some say they are failing miserably in that effort, even though every Rokea representative will very eagerly educate all who come within earshot about the differences between ladders and a vertical mobility enhancement device. Perhaps this communications strategy is part of the reason nobody cares.
zh: 火箭联合公司主要以“垂直机动增强”系列产品闻名，他们花了很大力气确保不被误认为只是简单的“梯子”。尽管该公司所有的销售代表都会迫不及待地为每个来访者解释梯子和垂直机动增强设备的区别，还是有人说他们的努力是徒劳的。也许这种沟通策略也是没人鸟他们的原因之一。

en: Many question the reasoning behind Sean's Cannery's -known for their very excellent canned foods products- incursion into the aerospace engineering world. Despite the criticism, none can dispute that their flagship product, the Lander Can Mk2 Cockpit, has proven itself many times over as a reliable and perhaps not surprisingly, one of the most air-tight crew carrying modules available today. Lander Can crews often praise the module for its ability to keep stowed snacks crisp and fresh, and complain of how on other pods they become mushy after just a few days into the mission.
zh: 有不少人质疑Sean罐头厂进入航天工业领域的原因，毕竟他们是以高品质罐头食品而著称的。尽管批评的声音不少，但没人能够否认他们的旗舰产品，着陆器密封罐Mk2驾驶舱，已承受了多次考验，而且它并不出人意料地是当今市场上气密性最好的一款乘员运输组件。用过着陆器密封罐的乘员们经常对该产品称赞有加，表示放在里面的零食能够一直保持酥脆新鲜，而在其他驾驶舱中只放几天就会变软。

en: STEADLER is not known for being a very kind or yielding company. Rather, militaristic, stern and uncompromising are much more fitting adjectives to describe them. Some say these are good qualities for a company responsible mainly for engineering control systems for rockets and hypersonic aircraft, while others suggest that the company is actually being run by a rogue Guidance Module that achieved sentience. All we really know is that their gate security is much too Temperamental to allow for any observation, and that their stun guns recharge very quickly.
zh: STEADLER并非以善良或妥协而闻名的公司，形容这家公司的时候用军事化、严厉和毫不让步应该更合适。有人觉得对一家主要负责研发火箭和超音速飞行器的工程学控制系统的企业来说，这些算是优秀品质，而其他人则认为这家公司其实是被一个获得了智能的导航模块控制了。我们知道的只有他们的门禁系统十分喜怒无常，无法进行任何观察，以及他们家的电击枪充能非常快。

en: One of the largest manufacturers of structural components for any purpose, StrutCo is by all measures a very well-established company. The only thing they have never been able to get over is the fact that the legendary EAS-4 Strut Connector itself was actually invented by Kerlington Model Rockets.
zh: 支柱公司作为最大的结构组件生厂商之一，各种意义上都是一家运转良好的公司。只有一件事让他们耿耿于怀，那就是传奇般的EAS-4支柱连接器竟然是坎灵顿模型火箭公司发明的。

en: Vac-Co is a relatively new name in the industry. With previous experience only as a manufacturer of housecleaning equipment and small appliances, their recent venture into aerospace engineering has been met with no small amount of skepticism. Nevertheless, they seem to know what they're doing, as their products have been quite innovative in the air intakes for spaceplanes sector.
zh: 真空公司在业内相对资历尚浅。由于之前只有过生产家庭清洁设备和小型家电的经验，最近他们进军航天工业的举动饱受冷嘲热讽。尽管如此，他们的表现似乎还算不错，其生产的空天飞机用进气道颇有新意。

en: WinterOwl is by no means comparable to other large aircraft companies in terms of sheer number of products they offer. However, the company is one of the best-known names in the industry as it's one of the oldest companies in operation. This has earned them a reputation for being a friendly, reliable partner, which means they have good standings with many other companies. In the aerospace circles, it is considered very poor manners to be rude about WinterOwl or its products.
zh: 从所提供产品的数量级来看，冬鸮无论如何都无法与其他飞行器大厂相比。然而，这家公司是行业内历史最悠久的企业之一，因此颇有声望。他们作为友善、可靠的合作伙伴广为人知，这意味着他们与很多其他公司都关系良好。在航天圈中，对冬鸮或其产品不敬被认为是非常失礼的。

en: Zaltonics isn't exactly known as a strong leader in the electronic components industry, rather more as a somewhat utilitarian company that lacks a certain amount of ambition. These traits however, have made Zaltonic indispensable in their own way, as they are willing to take on the manufacturing of the less exciting devices, and they've become quite good at doing that in a quick and cost-effective way. Their products might not be all the rage, but when your fancy remote guidance unit runs out of juice, chances are you'll be using a Zaltonics battery to keep it powered.
zh: 泽通并不是作为电子组件行业的领先者而闻名，更像是一家缺乏野心的功利主义公司。但是这一特点使泽通以独特的方式占有了一席之地，因为他们愿意承担不起眼设备的制造工作，并且很擅长用快速低成本的方式完成任务。他们的产品可能不怎么激动人心，不过当你酷炫的远程制导单元能量见底之后，就很有可能需要用泽通生产的电池为其提供能源。

en: Advanced Reaction Wheel Module, Large
zh: 大型高级动量轮模块

en: After many years of research, STEADLER Corps rocket engineers discovered that large flywheels were necessary to keep large ships under control. The "Advanced Reaction Wheel Module, Large" addresses that issue by its use of patented Large Flywheels™ to provide "More Torque" (patent pending). STEADLER promptly dismissed all criticism concerning the necessity of so much research work, stating that 'it only sounds so simple now that we've figured it out'. Critics remain skeptical, but none can disagree that this module does indeed pack a lot more punch than previous models. It also needs a lot more power, but STEADLER is currently carrying out intense research work on why that is.
zh: 经过多年研究，STEADLER公司的火箭工程师们发现，要想保持对大型飞船的操控，大型飞轮必不可少。“大型高级动量轮模块”应运而生，它使用了大型飞轮来提供“更强扭力”（专利申请中）。因此STEADLER公司立刻阻止了外界对相关研究工作的批评，并发表声明说：“它就是那样简单，我们已经找到了答案。”虽然评论家们对此仍持保留意见，但没有人能否认这款模块的确比过去的机型都更强大。尽管它仍然需要耗费更多的电能，但STEADLER正继续着手寻找解决之道。

en: After extensive research and testing to improve the safety factor of next-generation modules for their Mk2 series, engineers at C7 Aerospace got fed up with having to constantly find new recruits willing to test their prototypes, and decided to develop an autonomous AI capable of doing the same job, only with a lot less screaming over the comms link. This was met with divided opinions, some criticizing C7 as taking the "booooring" route, others praising them for the innovation, while yet others reacted by shutting themselves in bunkers in anticipation of the time when these units will gain sentience and turn on their creators. C7 has vehemently denied any involvement in all sentient-AI-related catastrophes so far.
zh: 在经过为MK2系列开发下一代模块而进行的大量研究和测试之后，C7航天部门的工程师们受够了天天寻找乐意帮助测试原型机的新人的日子，转而决定开发一种能够胜任这项工作，却不会在通讯环节发出那么多惨叫声的自动化AI。人们对这一决定褒贬不一，一些人批评C7选择了一条“无无无无无趣”的路线，另一些人则为这一创举表示赞赏。当然还有一些人表示应当在合适的时候就按计划让它们自动关闭电源，因为一旦它获得了自我意识，它就会转而对抗它们的造物主。然而迄今为止，C7都矢口否认他们涉及了任何与有意识的AI相关的活动。

Instead of relying on single engines or solid rocket boosters, the KR-1x2 employs two modified KR-1 engine, fed by a built-in fuel system, as the source of its immense lifting power. All that self-contained goodness comes at the cost of not having a mounting point for its underside, and not being quite as efficient as dedicated engines. It also comes at quite a literal cost as well.

en: This engine is Kerbodyne's first attempt at a highly advanced engine. The engineers couldn't get it to produce full efficiency at sea level without the engine exploding, so it was repurposed as an upper stage engine. The experience gained here with high efficiency has been repurposed for later models, which feature multiple combustion chambers at higher pressure (that don't go boom). This engine is optimized for lighting mid-flight, although it still provides respectable power at sea level.

en: S3 KS-25x4 "Mammoth" Liquid Fuel Engine
zh: S3 KS-25x4“猛犸”液体燃料引擎

en: Kerbodyne engineers got fed up with having to contend with overly complicated staging arrays for lifting heavy payloads, and decided instead to just build a truly enormous engine of the highest efficiency. Strapping together four of Kerbodyne's KS-25 rocket motors in a single assembly, they created the largest rocket engine in production anywhere, and each KS-25 has the highest chamber pressure--the reason for four small nozzles and combustion chambers, not one big one (those kept going boom). It's certainly got the power to match its size, and although it excels in its main role as a first-stage engine, the lack of structural hardpoints on its underside makes it quite less suitable for other purposes. Its price tag also seems to match its size, in fact.
zh: 由于对要发射重型装备就不得不弄出超复杂分级队列的争执让人不胜其烦，坎巴拉动力公司的工程师们决定要制造一台真正的巨无霸引擎，用来得到超强动力。他们将四台坎巴拉动力KS-25火箭引擎捆在一起，然后就创造出了有史以来最大的火箭引擎，每台KS-25都拥有最高的室压，因为四个小型的喷管和燃烧室比一个大的好（太大会变成炸弹）。它的动力也毫无疑问对得起它的规格，然而它主要适合作为第一级引擎，因为其下方缺乏可连接节点，不怎么适合其他用途。顺便它的价钱也同样对得起它的规格。

en: The VR-N1ER Veer-Governor, or "Vernor" Engine is an attitude control thruster. These motors are linked to RCS controls, but are powered by a Fuel+Oxidizer mix, making them significantly more powerful than MonoPropellant-powered RCS thrusters. They are fairly more bulky in comparison though, and feature only one nozzle facing outwards, although most agree that is an acceptable trade-off for the additional punch they pack.
