en: Flight Control
zh: 飞行控制

en: Tumbling out of control may be fun, but our engineers insist there's more to rocket science than that.
zh: 完全失控的感觉可能挺好玩儿的，但是我们的工程师坚持认为火箭科学不止如此。

en: Advanced Rocketry
zh: 高级火箭学

en: A new step ahead in rocket technology.
zh: 火箭技术更进一步。

en: General Construction
zh: 通用建造学

en: New equipment to help out in keeping things stable, especially useful when the size of the spacecraft defies the current bounds of sanity.
zh: 让东西保持稳定的新设备，对尺寸比较离奇的物体尤其有用。

en: Propulsion Systems
zh: 推进系统

en: A positively different approach to existing trends in rocketry. These small, lightweight propulsion systems may not seem as exciting, but they might prove just as useful.
zh: 现有火箭科学流派的一个激进的分支。这些个头不大、重量很轻的推进系统可能看上去没那么激动人心，但也一样有用。

en: Space Exploration
zh: 太空探索

en: To boldly go where no green man has gone before.
zh: 勇敢地前往小绿人从未涉足的领域。

en: Advanced Flight Control
zh: 高级飞行控制

en: The latest advancements in keeping the correct end of the ship pointing towards where you want it to go.
zh: 用于将飞船正确指向你的目标的最新技术进步。

en: Landing
zh: 着陆

en: Our Engineers are nothing if not optimistic.
zh: 我们的工程师最乐观不过了。

en: Aerodynamics
zh: 空气动力学

en: New breakthroughs from C7 Aerospace allow for new types of craft to be built. We're looking into hiring some of their engineers as well.
zh: C7航空的新突破使新型飞行器得以诞生。我们也在尝试把他们的工程师挖过来。

en: Electrics
zh: 电学

en: We did know about electricity before inventing space flight. The big breakthrough here was combining the two.
zh: 在发明宇宙航行之前，我们就已经对电学有所了解。真正的突破是将二者结合起来。

en: Heavy Rocketry
zh: 重型火箭学

en: The next logical step for rocketry technology is to just go bigger.
zh: 火箭技术比较理性的下一步发展就是继续变大。

en: Fuel Systems
zh: 燃料系统

en: Advancements towards a better understanding of how fuel flows through a rocket.
zh: 对燃料如何在火箭中流动的最新研究进展。

en: Advanced Construction
zh: 高级建造学

en: New advances in construction make it possible to build larger than ever before.
zh: 建造学的新进展让我们可以建造比以前更大的玩意。

en: Miniaturization
zh: 微型化

en: These aren't your standard hobby miniature models. We've been assured they look good enough to actually fly.
zh: 这些并不是普通的微缩模型。有人向我们保证它们能够飞起来。

en: Actuators
zh: 传动机构

en: Perfecting the art of making things mobile, without the explicit use of explosives. Our engineers assure us, this is actually a good thing.
zh: 进一步完善不用大量依靠炸药，就能让东西动起来的艺术。我们的工程师保证，这其实是件好事。

en: Command Modules
zh: 指令舱

en: Flight control technology has evolved far enough that we feel we can honestly say pilots are in command now.
zh: 飞行控制技术的发展已经让我们能自豪地说，飞行员现在可以真正掌控全局。

en: Heavier Rocketry
zh: 更重型的火箭学

en: There may be an upper limit to how large a rocket can be built, but we're not there yet.
zh: 也许火箭的大小终将有上限，但我们目前还没有达到。

en: Precision Engineering
zh: 精确加工学

en: Precise engineering techniques allow for construction of ever smaller parts.
zh: 精确加工技术可以用于制造更小的部件。

en: Advanced Exploration
zh: 高级探索

en: They are Self-Deploying Astronaut Mobility Enhancement Devices, I don't know what you mean by "ladders".
zh: 这是自动展开宇航员机动增强设备，我不懂你说的“梯子”是什么意思。

en: Specialized Control
zh: 专业控制

en: A new state-of-the-art in control technology.
zh: 控制技术的全新艺术高度。

en: Advanced Landing
zh: 高级着陆

en: Further advances in landing devices, allowing for more controlled descents and a much higher number of parts still attached to the ship after touchdown.
zh: 在着陆设备领域的深远进步使可控降落更加精确，落地后也会有更多部件还连在飞机上。

en: Supersonic Flight
zh: 超音速飞行

en: A new line of aircraft parts that allow for unprecedented maneuverability and speed.
zh: 一系列新的飞行器部件提供了前所未有的机动性和速度。

en: Adv. Fuel Systems
zh: 高级燃料系统

en: Advanced Advancements towards a better understanding of how fuel flows through a rocket.
zh: 对燃料如何在火箭中流动的最新尖端研究进展。

en: Advanced Electrics
zh: 高级电学

en: We're fairly certain no one will ever need more than 64kw of power for anything.
zh: 我们非常肯定，没有人会需要超过64千瓦的电能。

en: Specialized Construction
zh: 专业建造学

en: Specialized construction techniques provide new ways of attaching things together, and detaching things on purpose.
zh: 专业建造学提供了将东西固定在一起或是把它们分开的新方法。

en: Precision Propulsion
zh: 精确推进

en: Any level of precision achieved in controlling the sustained explosion inside a rocket engine is nothing short of remarkable. It might be quite expensive, too.
zh: 任何更精确地控制火箭引擎内部持续不断爆炸的领域的新进展都是令人赞叹的。当然，也是价格不菲的。

en: Advanced Aerodynamics
zh: 高级空气动力学

en: Advances in fluid dynamics research technology have allowed development of a new set of streamlined aircraft components, And also these parts here.
zh: 流体动力学技术研究的进展促成了一系列全新流线型飞行器组件，以及这里这些部件的开发工作。

en: Heavy Landing
zh: 重型着陆

en: A good landing is one where you walk away from it. A great landing is one where you get to use the aircraft again.
zh: 一次出色的着陆就是让你活着走出飞行器。而一次牛掰的着陆就是这艘飞行器你下次还能继续用。

en: Scanning Tech
zh: 扫描技术

en: Why wonder about what's over the next hill when you can wonder about what's under it?
zh: 如果你能搞清楚山下面是什么，为什么还要费心去想山后面是什么呢？

en: Unmanned Tech
zh: 无人操控技术

en: Warning: May contain traces of sentience.
zh: 警告：可能带有靠直觉来的痕迹。

en: Nuclear Propulsion
zh: 核动力推进

en: Nuclear engines don't burn fuel, they totally annihilate it. We just hope it doesn't begin any conflicts.
zh: 核引擎不燃烧燃料，只会让燃料彻底湮灭。我们只希望这不会造成任何冲突。

en: Advanced MetalWorks
zh: 高级金属加工

en: These new construction techniques allow for craft designs that were considered insane not too long ago... and still are. But they're now possible!
zh: 这些新的制造技术使我们可以实现不久以前还被认为过于疯狂的航空器设计，这些设计现在也有些疯狂。但是毕竟已经可以实现了！

en: Field Science
zh: 野外科研

en: Freedom to roam as far as curiosity will take you, or as long as batteries last.
zh: 自由就是任由好奇心把你带去任何地方，当然要在电池续航能力允许范围内。

en: High Altitude Flight
zh: 高海拔飞行

en: New breakthroughs in engine and intake development to enable flying through the upper reaches of the atmosphere.
zh: 引擎和进气道领域的新进步让我们能在大气层的最高处飞行。

en: Large Volume Containment
zh: 高容积承载

en: Maximize the payload capacity of your spacecraft by maximizing the size of your spacecraft.
zh: 通过最大化飞船体积，实现最大化其载荷容量。

en: Composites
zh: 复合材料

en: Lightweight and strong! and don't worry, we're sure the glue will dry off in no time.
zh: 重量轻，强度大！别担心，胶水一会儿就干了。

en: Electronics
zh: 电子学

en: Hopefully these won't become obsolete in the next couple of months.
zh: 希望几个月之后这些依然没有过时。

en: High-Power Electrics
zh: 高能电学

en: Maximize your energy production and storage potential by maximizing the size of the electrical components on your vessels.
zh: 通过最大化航天器上的电子元件尺寸，达到最大化的能量生成和储存能力。

en: Heavy Aerodynamics
zh: 重型空气动力学

en: Advances in construction technology enabled new breakthroughs in aerospace materials.
zh: 建造技术的进步带来了空气动力学材料方面的突破。

en: Ion Propulsion
zh: 离子推进

en: Turns out, it's not science fiction.
zh: 原来，这不是科幻小说啊。

en: Hypersonic Flight
zh: 超音速飞行

en: Push your aircraft to the upper limits of airspeed and sanity.
zh: 将你的飞行器推向空速和理智的极限。

en: Nanolathing
zh: 纳米加工

en: Despite the threatening appearance of the green metablobs shot out of the Nanolathing Injectors, none can argue the fact that Kerbals have indeed developed technologies at least just as dangerous as this one.
zh: 尽管纳米加工注塑机有时候会喷射出一些看上去很可怕的大块绿色物质，但我们得承认，坎巴拉人以前也曾经研究过至少和这个差不多危险的技术。

en: Advanced Unmanned Tech
zh: 高级无人操控技术

en: Improvements in remote control technology for a new generation of probe designs.
zh: 远程控制技术的进步带来了新一代探测器设计。

en: Meta-Materials
zh: 超级合成材料

en: An advancement in spacecraft construction so revolutionary, you won't even mind that its naming was wildly inaccurate.
zh: 飞船建造领域革命性的进展让你忘记了它的名字跟内容其实毫不相关。

en: Very Heavy Rocketry
zh: 特别重型的火箭学

en: While ever-larger rockets may not be the answer every time, for all other times, we've developed these.
zh: 尽管把火箭造得越来越大可能不是永恒的答案，但我们还是研发了这个。

en: Advanced Science Tech
zh: 高级科学技术

en: Scientific advancements allow new advanced technologies for advancing Science.
zh: 随着科学进步，发展科学的技术也有了新的进展。

en: Advanced Motors
zh: 高级马达

en: Wheel technology is just rolling along now. You could even say our engineers are on a roll with it.
zh: 车轮技术已经在向前滚动前进了。你也可以说我们的工程师们现在鸿运滚滚。

en: Specialized Electrics
zh: 专业电学

en: Experience the warm glow of the latest in electrical technology. Figuratively, of course, and maybe also quite literally as well. Actually, try to avoid direct exposure.
zh: 来体验最新的电子科技温暖的光芒吧。这当然是个比喻，不过也可以说是现实。当然要小心，避免直接受到照射。

en: High-Performance Fuel Systems
zh: 高性能燃料系统

en: Massive engines require massive fuel storage solutions.
zh: 大型引擎需要大型燃料存储解决方案。

en: Experimental Aerodynamics
zh: 试验阶段空气动力学

en: Winged flight technology is soaring to unprecedented heights. It could even be said that it's properly taking off now.
zh: 有翼飞行技术正达到前所未有的高度。甚至可以说，现在已经顺利起飞了。

en: Automation
zh: 自动化

en: We can't think of anything that could go wrong with letting an experimental AI handle every aspect of a mission.
zh: 让一个试验阶段的人工智能来掌控任务的方方面面会有什么问题呢，我们实在想不出来。

en: Aerospace Tech
zh: 空天技术

en: The absolute cutting-edge in aerospace technology. Quite literally, some of those edges are very sharp. Handle with care.
zh: 航空技术真正的尖端。说真的，有些地方真的很尖。操作的时候一定要小心。

en: Large Probes
zh: 大型探测器

en: The rumours of probe-led world domination are greatly exaggerated.
zh: 关于探测器将会统治世界的传言实在是太夸张了。

en: Experimental Science
zh: 试验阶段科学

en: Explore novel fields of science that we didn't even know were there.
zh: 探索全新的科学领域，我们之前甚至不知道这些领域的存在。

en: Experimental Motors
zh: 试验阶段马达

en: The latest breakthroughs that are driving motor technology forwards, and in reverse, and steering too.
zh: 推动马达技术，以及倒车和转向技术方面进步的最新进展。

en: Experimental Electrics
zh: 试验阶段电学

en: The very latest in electrical systems technology. Our engineers are buzzing with excitement over it. They also seem to glow in the dark now. Fascinating!
zh: 电气系统技术的最前沿领域。我们的工程师对此兴奋不已，顺便他们现在好像都变成夜光的了。不可思议！

en: He's an accountant, called Mortimer. He doesn't have many friends, but he likes things to be under control and arranged in right angles. This job is pretty stressful for him.
zh: 他是个会计师，名叫Mortimer。他没什么朋友，但是喜欢运筹帷幄，有条不紊的感觉。这份工作给了他很大压力。

en: Linus is Wernher Von Kerman's Intern. Because Wernher himself is too important to be bothered with these boring strategy meetings. He sends his intern in his stead.
zh: Linus是Wernher von Kerman手下的实习生。由于Wernher本人无暇抽空参加这些无聊的策略会议，因此每次都让实习生代为出席。

en: Walt Kerman is the spokesperson for the Space Program. He wears a hazmat suit. Which isn't strictly required for his job, but it seems appropriate for someone working in such a toxic environment.
zh: Walt Kerman是太空计划的发言人。他总是穿着一身生化防护服，尽管他的工作对此并无严格要求，但对于一个在这种毒气四溢的环境中工作的人来说，这也算是合理的。

en: Gus Kerman is head of Space Program Operations and all-around repairs guy whenever something around here breaks down, and he's the reason why all our pods have windows.
zh: Gus Kerman是太空计划运营的负责人，以及负责所有设备故障的全能修理工。也是因为他，我们的指令舱才会都有窗户。

en: Appreciation Campaign
zh: 普及宣传

en: We could definitely improve our image by putting some effort into reminding Kerbals everywhere of just how great the Space Program is. Advertisement space isn't free, however.
zh: 如果能让世界各地的坎巴拉人都意识到太空计划有多么棒，一定能改善我们的形象。但是租广告位可不是免费的。

en: Fundraising Campaign
zh: 募捐游说

en: We can likely raise some money by exploiting the attention that we get out of new successful ventures to remind the well-to-do Kerbals out there that we could use their support, and the contents of their wallets. This is probably going to be seen as a bit cheeky of us, so be prepared to face some backlash from the public.
zh: 我们可以通过充分利用成功的新探险吸引到的关注，来提醒富裕阶级的坎巴拉人们，我们需要他们的支持，以及他们钱包里装的东西，这样就能筹到一点资金了。这样做很可能会显得我们有些厚脸皮，所以需要做好面对舆论反弹的准备。

en: Open-Source Tech Program
zh: 开源技术项目

en: Even though we went through great lengths to get our scientific data, making it available for free to all of Kerbalkind can only be seen as a good thing. R&D will probably not be at its peak efficiency however, with all the noise these outside opinions tend to generate.
zh: 尽管我们的科学数据都是费了好大劲儿才收集到的，但让所有坎巴拉人都能免费获取肯定是件好事。不过在外界舆论引发的干扰下，研发中心的效率可能会受到影响。

en: Unpaid Research Program
zh: 无偿研究项目

en: A program where undergrad researchers are given the opportunity to work in our great Space Program, to boost the science earned out of each mit of data. The Interns don't get paid, but the prestige of working with such a grand organization as ours surely is its own reward, isn't it?
zh: 一个为在校研究者提供参与伟大太空计划机会的项目，旨在将我们所获取的每一条数据中蕴藏的科学价值都充分提取出来。这些实习生没有报酬，但在我们这样的大型机构中工作所获得的的名望本身就是一种报酬，不是吗？

en: Outsourced R&D
zh: 外包研发

en: Why do all the data-crunching ourselves when we can contract external research labs to help us process the data we receive. These services aren't exactly cheap, but their R&D facilities are very impressive.
zh: 既然我们能通过合同让外部研究实验室帮我们处理收到的数据，为什么还要亲自去压榨那些数据呢？这种服务并不便宜，但他们的研发设施的确令人刮目相看。

en: Patents Licensing
zh: 专利授权

en: Our science data can be worth a lot of money by selling licenses for other organizations to use our patents. The added book-keeping required will probably add some extra work for the R&D team, but the financial benefits could be worth their reduced output.
zh: 通过向其他机构出售使用我们专利的授权，科学数据会变得很值钱。额外的记录工作可能会为研发小组带来更多工作量，但产生的经济效益足以弥补他们产出的下降。

en: Aggressive Negotiations
zh: 强势谈判

en: We can get better deals with our suppliers by taking up a more... assertive stance on our negotiations with them. They probably won't see this as a friendly move, but we can definitely have it our way if we press them. It's not as if we care what others think, do we?
zh: 如果在和供应商谈判时，能拿出更强硬的态度，也许能得到更高的折扣。他们也许会觉得这一手很不友善，但如果我们坚持，一定能达到目的。反正我们从不在意他人的想法，对吧？

en: Recovery Transponder Fitting
zh: 回收应答装置

en: Recovering parts landed far away from the Space Center can be very costly, but I reckon we can reduce those costs by installing better transponders on the parts we launch. These units are not cheap, but they should make it much easier to find parts, improving the recovery value even if they're half-way around Kerbin. What do you say?
zh: 回收着陆点距离太空中心很远的部件成本可能很高，但我想如果在发射的部件上安装更好的应答器，就能降低成本了。这些装置不便宜，但会让寻找部件的难度大大降低，即使隔着半个Kerbin，回收的性价比也能得到改善。你怎么看？

en: Bail-Out Grant
zh: 应急资金

en: We must be in dire straits to be considering such an option. Accepting a public grant could save us from bankruptcy, but it would also put a very serious dent in the Space Program's reputation. However, the Space Program is too big to fail, so if it's either this option or closing shop, I would advise you to accept the money.
zh: 我们必须是在走投无路时，才考虑使用这个选项。接受公共资金能让我们免于破产，但也会让太空计划名声扫地。但是，太空计划太重要了，不允许失败，所以如果真的到了不启动这个方案就会关门大吉的地步，我还是建议你接受该资金。

en: Research Rights Sell-Out
zh: 研发权拍卖

en: We could make a quick buck from the Science the R&D team has collected by selling exclusive research rights to the highest bidder. Yes, that means we wouldn't be able to make use of that Science ourselves, but for exclusive rights, I'm sure we could fetch a pretty penny from some large agency or conglomerate.
zh: 我们可以通过将独家研发权授予出价最高的一方，迅速从研发小组收集的科学点数中赚上一笔。是的，这意味着我们自己不能利用这些科技点了，但我敢保证独家授权能让我们从某个大型机构或集团狠赚一笔。

en: Leadership Initiative
zh: 领先主动权

en: If we focus our efforts on consistently pushing our own space program forward, we can drum up more public interest. We will need to put a few contracts on the backburner, so we may have to start selling research rights to the academic community to stay solvent.
zh: 如果我们一直专注于不断将我们自己的空间计划向前推进，就能吸引到更多公众关注。这样一来，我们就需要把一些合同暂时搁置了，因此可能需要向学术群体出售研究授权，保持收支平衡。

en: You record the crew's assessment of the situation.
zh: 你记录了乘员对当前情况的评估结果。

en: We don't seem to be moving very fast right now.
zh: 我们现在的移动速度不是很高。

en: Reporting in at the Runway. Good thing there's not a lot of air traffic, because I don't think we ever got clearance from the tower to be here.
zh: 来自跑道的报告。还好现在机场不是很繁忙，因为我觉得指挥塔好像没有同意我们进入跑道。

en: This is our Space Center. We're home.
zh: 这里是我们的太空中心。我们到家了。

en: Hey, I can see my house from here, I think.
zh: 嘿，我想从这儿能看到我家的房子。

en: It's very comforting to see that much green below you.
zh: 看着脚下大片的绿色，令人心神安宁。

en: You get a great view of the highlands.
zh: 从这儿可以将整个高原一览无遗。

en: The mountains rise up from the ground of Kerbin. They seem so much smaller from way up here.
zh: 群山在Kerbin大地上高高耸立。从这里看，它们变得如此渺小。

en: The heat rising from the sand causes the desert to move and shimmer.
zh: 沙子中蒸腾而起的热气让沙漠看起来像是一直在摇晃，并且闪闪发光。

en: This looks like a bad place to land.
zh: 这儿看上去不太适合降落。

en: You see patches of frozen grass. It looks like it's pretty cold out there.
zh: 能看到一片片冻住的草地，外面好像很冷啊。

en: You look down and see a sheet of shining white ice. If you stare at it too long your eyes start to water.
zh: 如果你往下看，可以看到一大片亮晶晶的白色冰面。如果盯着看太久，就会开始流眼泪。

en: The shores look inviting and you watch the waves roll in to the coast.
zh: 海岸看上去很诱人，海浪不停拍打着沙滩。

en: From this perspective you can see the underwater topography.
zh: 从这个角度可以看到水下地形。

en: It seems we are very much in space right now. The sky seems to be mostly below us.
zh: 我们好像已经进入太空了，天空似乎已经在我们脚下。

en: Maybe if you get out and push...
zh: 如果你出去推一下…

en: It's very... round.
zh: 它看上去…很圆。

en: Crew reporting in, from space!
zh: 乘员报告，来自太空！

en: You look down at the cold gray surface. It looks really beat up with craters.
zh: 你看着下方冷峻的灰色地面，上面遍布着环形山。

en: You look at the surface of the Mun and try to find a good landing space. The inside of the craters might be the best option.
zh: 你看着Mun的地面，并试图找到理想的着陆点。环形山内部也许是最好的选择了。

en: The lake beds seem relatively flat, perhaps we could land there.
zh: 湖床看上去比较平坦，也许我们可以在这里着陆。

en: Looking at the surface of Minmus reminds you of a favorite childhood dessert. You are tempted to taste the surface...
zh: Minmus的地表让你想起了自己孩童时最喜欢的甜点。你很想尝尝地面的味道…

en: It looks like a particularly lumpy rock. Bet you could jetpack down there.
zh: 看上去像是一大块岩石。我敢打赌，用喷气背包可以降落到那里。

en: The planet doesn't appear to have an atmosphere, and you notice darker spots across the surface.
zh: 这颗行星好像没有大气层，你注意到地表分布着一些深色斑点。

en: You can't help but notice how incredibly purple the planet is. The shiny oceans are mesmerizing.
zh: 你注意到这颗行星是彻头彻尾的紫色，波光粼粼的海洋让人不禁出神。

en: The planet is very red, and appears to have deep brown furrows across the surface. There does appear to be some kind of ice at both poles, though.
zh: 这颗行星是红色的，表面还有深棕色沟壑。不过两极好像还有某种类似冰面的东西。

en: You can't help but like Ike.
zh: 你不由得喜欢上了Ike。

en: There appear to be some steep, rocky slopes. The higher areas are lighter in color, and the lowlands appear to be very dark gray.
zh: 那边好像有一些陡峭的岩石斜坡。更高的地方颜色较浅，低处则是深灰色。

en: Looking down, you see a massive canyon on the surface. It could be several kilometers deep.
zh: 你向下望去，就会看到地表有一条巨大的峡谷，深度可能有数公里。

en: The surface has a patchwork of white and brown areas, with a few craters.
zh: 这里的地表像是白色和棕色地块的拼图，再加上几个环形山脉。

en: You watch the flowing green storms below, they seem to go on forever, endlessly swirling into each other.
zh: 你看着脚下漂浮的绿色风暴，它们好像永无止息，不停绕着彼此旋转。

en: This planet is a wholesome green color. You note down that more planets should be this color.
zh: 这颗行星是完全的绿色。你在笔记中写道，这种颜色的行星应该再多一些。

en: Laythe looks a lot like Kerbin. You wonder what would happen if you took your helmet off down there.
zh: Laythe和Kerbin看上去很像。你不禁想到，如果在这里摘下头盔会怎么样。

en: The surface is mostly covered in oceans. You mark down the landmasses in your report.
zh: 地表大部分被海洋覆盖。你在报告中标出了陆地的位置。

en: The surface has many impressive and jagged mountain ranges. You do not think you'd like to try and land on them.
zh: 这里的地表有很多高耸入云的险峻山脉，你可不想在这里尝试着陆。

en: The moon is mostly white and lighter blue shades. It looks very cold and possibly frozen.
zh: 这颗卫星基本由白色和淡蓝色的色块组成，看上去十分寒冷，可能已经结冻了。

en: It looks like it would be very hard to land here. It also appears one side is more heavily cratered than the other.
zh: 在这里降落的难度看上去很高。另外，有一侧的环形山好像比另一侧要多。

en: The surface is covered with various shades of white and gray. For a second you thought you saw a face down there...
zh: 地表被各种白色和灰色的区域覆盖。有那么一瞬间，你觉得这些色块拼成了一张脸的形状…

en: It appears to be a large brown rock. Perhaps an old asteroid?
zh: 看上去像一块棕色的大岩石。也许是一颗古老的小行星？

en: As you stare at the planet, something flits by the window. Is there something moving down there?
zh: 就在你盯着行星看的时候，有什么东西从窗外一闪而过。下面有什么在动吗？

en: It looks like a really large grain of pollen. You note down -Pol- in your report.
zh: 这儿看上去就像一颗巨大的的花粉。你在报告中注了一个“粉”字。

en: The terrain below looks very hazardous. You make note of the jagged rocks, inclines and other dangerous areas.
zh: 脚下的地面看上去很危险，你记下了锯齿状的岩石、斜坡和其他危险的地区。

en: The surface appears to be mostly frozen. You see some interesting brown areas peeking out of the ice and note them in your report.
zh: 地表看上去基本是结冻状态。在冰面上，你看到了一些有趣的棕色区域露了出来，于是在报告上做了记录。

en: You search the sky for other nearby planets.  You think Eeloo must be lonely out here by itself. Maybe we should pay it a visit and cheer it up a bit.
zh: 你在天空中寻找附近其他行星。你觉得Eeloo自己在这里一定很寂寞。也许我们应该到那儿看看，让它振作起来。

en: You've recorded your observations about the situation.
zh: 你记下了观察的结果。

en: It's getting very hot in here...
zh: 这儿越来越热了…

en: Everything is tinted purple. You feel like you're changing color.
zh: 一切都变成了紫色。你觉得自己也在变色。

en: Did you eat too much before you left? You feel so sluggish and heavy...
zh: 你出发前是不是吃得太多？感觉自己的身体如此笨拙而沉重…

en: You can barely move without flying away from the surface. You wish you had brought an anchor.
zh: 基本无法做到双脚不离地向前移动。你开始后悔没带个锚过来。

en: I don't think a spacesuit was entirely necessary to get here, was it?
zh: 我觉得在这里不需要穿宇航服，不是吗？

en: You feel kind of small right now... You hope you know where you're going.
zh: 你现在开始觉得自己有些渺小…你希望自己能分辨出自己的目的地是哪儿。

en: This is a most precarious situation.
zh: 情况很危险。

en: You're starting to feel you should really get back into the ship.
zh: 你开始觉得自己真的应该返回飞船了。

en: The dust is getting everywhere!
zh: 到处都是灰！

en: You look up and search the sky for Kerbin. Suddenly, you feel very small.
zh: 你抬起头，扫视着Kerbin的天空。突然，你感到自己很渺小。

en: You start to say something dramatic and poignant about the plight of Kerbal-kind in this grand universe, only to be cut off by random radio chatter that the situation is nominal.
zh: 你开始用戏剧化的尖锐口吻谈论Kerbin人在浩瀚宇宙中的困境，不过很快就被无线通信打断了，那头的人说这一切都不算什么。

en: You're having a bit too much fun with the low gravity.
zh: 在低重力环境中，你玩得有些忘乎所以了。

en: Is this really a good idea? Staring at the cratered surface below, you're beginning to wonder...
zh: 这真的是个好主意吗？看着脚下遍布环形山脉的地面，你不禁开始犹豫…

en: You feel a bit like a superhero when you jump in the low gravity.
zh: 在低重力环境中跳起时，你感到自己就像个超级英雄。

en: After much testing, you determine that red sand castles are plausible.
zh: 经过多次测验，你判断搭建一座红沙城堡是完全可行的。

en: Everywhere you look, you see red.
zh: 无论你看向哪里，都是一片红色。

en: You look up at the sky and see something zip past...
zh: 你抬头望天，看到什么东西一闪而过…

en: There's a bunch of large rocks scattered around the surface. The surface appears to react oddly to light.
zh: 地面上散落着一些大块岩石，反光效果很奇怪。

en: When you look closely at the ground, you can see there are many different types of deposits mixed together.
zh: 当你近距离观察时，发现这儿的地面是由多种不同的沉积物混合构成的。

en: You're not sure how you even landed on the surface of a gas giant. But it's probably best not to think about it for too long.
zh: 你都说不清自己是怎么降落在气态巨行星表面的。不过最好还是不要想得太多。

en: This place seems nice and comfortable. So comfortable you feel like taking your helmet off. You check the box on your report for -Looks breathable-.
zh: 这里看上去很舒适，你甚至想把头盔摘下来。在你的报告中，你在“看上去可以呼吸”一栏打上了对勾。

en: After a few long seconds of gasping and haphazardly flailing about you manage to get used to the strange smell. You write a note on your report: 'breathable atmosphere - mouth only'.
zh: 你摘下了头盔…随后的几秒钟显得十分漫长，你拼命呼吸，挣扎着再次戴上了头盔。随后，你把报告中关于可呼吸大气层的对勾擦掉了。

en: The surface occasionally rumbles beneath you. You think you should probably get back to the ship.
zh: 脚下的地面时不时隆隆作响。你觉得自己可能该返回飞船了。

en: The gravity here is pretty comfortable and reminds you of home. However, the lack of atmosphere is a stark contrast to Kerbin.
zh: 你很适应这里的重力，有一种家的感觉。不过，和Kerbin不同，这儿没有大气层。

en: The surface is very brown and lumpy. You poke at it with your glove and notice how hard it is.
zh: 这儿的地表是棕色的，凹凸不平。你戴着手套捅了一下地面，发现非常坚硬。

en: Everywhere you look it appears the planet is sharp. You don't think you want to sit down or fall on anything.
zh: 目力所及的范围内，这颗行星到处都很尖锐。你一点都不想在这里坐下或是摔在什么东西上。

en: You lay down and give the planet a hug, just so it knows it's not alone out here.
zh: 你趴下来，给这颗行星一个拥抱，让它感受到自己并不孤单。

en: You Observe the Goo.
zh: 你观察了黏性物质。

en: The Goo doesn't seem to be doing much right now.
zh: 黏性物质现在好像什么都没做。

en: The Goo seems to behave very much the same as it always does around here.
zh: 黏性物质的表现和其在这里的一贯表现没有任何差异。

en: The Goo seems to hate it here.
zh: 黏性物质好像不喜欢这里。

en: The Goo escapes into the water!
zh: 黏性物质逃进了水里！

en: The Goo wobbles around in its container and starts to seep out of the holes.
zh: 黏性物质在容器中晃来晃去，并开始从洞中渗透出来。

en: The Goo accumulates near the water-facing side of the container.
zh: 黏性物质在容器靠近水面的一边聚成一团。

en: The Goo seems bored.
zh: 黏性物质看上去有些无聊了。

en: The Goo jiggles and wobbles as the craft flies.
zh: 起飞后，黏性物质微微抖动，然后又开始晃来晃去。

en: The Goo seems to be getting very cold now.
zh: 黏性物质好像感到很冷。

en: The Goo seems to have clumped into a sphere. It also appears to have become brittle.
zh: 黏性物质变成了球状，看上去有些虚弱。

en: The Goo seems to be almost boiling. It writhes around the canister.
zh: 黏性物质看上去就要沸腾了，在容器中不停翻滚。

en: The Goo has become rubbery and bounces around the container.
zh: 黏性物质变得和橡胶一样，在容器内弹来弹去。

en: The Goo takes on a purple coloration. Is it just the lighting, or did it change color?
zh: 黏性物质变成了紫色。是光照原因，还是它自己会变色？

en: The Goo takes on a red sheen. It looks very much like the planet below.
zh: 黏性物质罩上了一层红色，看上去和下面的行星很像。

en: The Goo seems to be less dense here.
zh: 黏性物质在这里好像没那么粘稠了。

en: The Goo feels right at home here.
zh: 黏性物质在这里看上去很舒服。

en: The canister begins to resonate, causing an odd harmonic effect inside the vessel. It's very unsettling.
zh: 小罐开始共振，在航天器内引发了一种奇怪的和弦效果，令人不安。

en: Gooey tentacles reach out of the canister, freeze, and break off. Fascinating!
zh: 黏性触手伸出小罐，冻住，然后脱离本体。太惊人了！

en: While observing the canister, you feel as though something is looking back at you from the shadows of the container.
zh: 观察小罐时，你感到有什么东西正从容器内的阴暗角落盯着你看。

en: For a moment the instruments suddenly read off the charts! The container flexes outwards and then settles.
zh: 在一瞬间，仪器的读数突然激增！容器壁向外凸出来了一下，然后又恢复平静。

en: You've collected a sample of the surface.
zh: 你收集到了地表样本。

en: You dig around in the surface a bit, find something interesting, and throw it into a sample container.
zh: 你在地面上挖了几下，找到了一些有意思的东西，将其扔进了样本容器。

en: You poke at the ground looking for some really cool rocks to take home.
zh: 你在地面上捅来捅去，想找一些很酷的石头带回家。

en: Yep. Looks like dirt.
zh: 没错。看上去是土。

en: This is dirt and grass, and some small rocks. You suspect this isn't going to be much of a groundbreaking discovery.
zh: 这里有土和草，还有一些小石头。你开始怀疑这儿不会有什么突破性的发现。

en: Here the surface is mostly barren... snow, dirt and rocks. You're very confident that if you looked under the snow, you'd find more dirt and rocks.
zh: 这里的地表很贫瘠，只有雪、土和石头。你很确定如果翻开积雪，会看到更多土和石头。

en: Lots of sand and rocks here. You're thankful that you've been in a climate-controlled environment, because it sure looks hot out there. The sand is dry and loose and it looks like it's going to take some effort to clean your gear afterwards.
zh: 这儿有很多沙子和石头。你很感激自己置身于气候可控的环境中，因为外面看上去真的很热。沙子干燥松散，看来一会儿清理装备要花些力气了。

en: The ground here seems to be completely frozen. It was very hard to scoop up this sample.
zh: 这里的地面好像完全冻住了，想挖取一份样本很困难。

en: This isn't really solid ground, is it? You got a sample but feared to dig any deeper because of the startling cracking sounds the ice made. You try to not think back on how you landed here.
zh: 这儿不是真正的固体地面，对吧？你拿到了一份样本，但是冰层破裂的声音让你不敢挖得更深。你尽量不去回想自己是如何降落到这里的。

en: You took a sample of the soil. It's very muddy and sandy. There might be a body of water nearby.
zh: 你取了一份土壤样本。土质呈泥沙状。附近也许有水源。

en: The grass here is definitely not as green as other places, but the knowledge that you've been at a place called the Badlands makes you feel cool.
zh: 这里的草肯定没有其他地方那么绿，但造访一个叫做“荒地”的地方，让你感到自己很酷。

en: You scooped up a sample of the surface. It's a very humid sample.  You hope the equipment has been properly waterproofed.
zh: 你铲起了一块地表样本。样本很潮湿。希望设备的防水性能都经得住考验。

en: You've taken a sample of the water. It appears to dramatically increase the surface humidity of anything it touches.
zh: 你取了一份水体样本。样本接触到的任何东西表面都会变得非常潮湿。

en: You've taken a sample of the water here. There are bits of vegetation in it, suggesting a strong likelihood that there is land nearby.
zh: 你取了一份这里的水体样本。水中好像有植物微粒，说明附近很可能有陆地。

en: The surface is charred and coated with burnt rocket propellant. There are also trace amounts of a conspicuous green substance.
zh: 地表烧焦了，盖着一层烧过的火箭推进剂，还有少量显眼的绿色物质。

en: The surface appears to be very hard, like concrete. It might actually be concrete. This could be a very good surface to land at.
zh: 地表看上去很坚硬，像混凝土一样。也许就是混凝土。在这儿降落应该不错。

en: This substance is what makes the scientists yell at us when we go into the labs without cleaning our boots first.
zh: 这些物质就是害我们穿着脏靴子进入实验室时，遭到科学家呵斥的罪魁祸首。

en: The surface appears to be a fine dust with a grey-ish tone. Seems too flaky to make snowballs with.
zh: 地表看上去覆盖着灰色的尘土微粒，颗粒太小，应该不能做成雪球。

en: The darker midlands surface appears to be made up of basaltic rocks.
zh: 颜色较暗的中部地区地表似乎是由玄武岩层构成的。

en: The sample contains odd glass spherules of various colors. They're quite pretty!
zh: 样本中有奇怪的微型彩色玻璃球体，真漂亮！

en: The sample contains evidence of a weak, localized, magnetic field.
zh: 样本证明当地存在一个区域性弱磁场。

en: The surface here consists of multiple types of rock. Some appear almost crystalline.
zh: 这里的地面由多种岩石构成，有一些形态接近晶体。

en: The sample contains a combination of breccia and melted materials.
zh: 样本是角砾岩和融化物质的混合。

en: There are higher concentrations of metals in this crater than from other locations.
zh: 这里的环形山脉中金属浓度比其他地方高。

en: The ground materials appear to be a combination of basaltic rocks and breccia.
zh: 地面是由玄武岩和角砾岩混合构成的。

en: Deeper samples seem to contain more fragmented and shattered formations of rock.
zh: 更深层样本中的岩石结构好像断裂更严重一些。

en: The sample appears to be radioactive.
zh: 样本好像有放射性。

en: There appear to be layers of completely different materials here.  It's possible this site has had multiple impacts.
zh: 这里看上去有多层完全不同的物质，这个地方有可能受到过多次冲击。

en: There are large concentrations of melted byproducts here. Some appear to be formed by intense pressures and heat.
zh: 这里聚集了大量融化的副产品，有些看上去是在巨大压力和高温下形成的。

en: Samples from this location appear to be similar in makeup to the powdery surface of the Mun.
zh: 这个位置的样本成分与Mun充满粉尘的表面成分相似。

en: Samples in this location are striated. It's possible that the surface has fractured in this location.
zh: 这个地方的样本带有条纹，地表可能发生过断裂。

en: Samples from this location seem to show intense shock patterns.
zh: 这个位置的样本呈现出受到强烈震动后的形态。

en: It appears that some of the samples are magnetic and show a faint alignment.
zh: 有些样本带有磁性，并且有隐约的阵列形态。

en: The samples here show lower concentrations of ejecta. There appear to be some liquids in the soil that remain permanently frozen.
zh: 这里的样本中的火山沉积物浓度要低一些，看上去土壤中似乎有一些凝固的岩浆。

en: Samples seems to contain frozen liquids... We'll need to send them back to Kerbin for further analysis.
zh: 样本中包含火成岩。我们需要将其送回Kerbin进行更多分析。

en: The sample appears to be comprised of a large number of materials layered over time.
zh: 这份样本是由多种物质长年累月一层一层沉积而成的。

en: The sample contains lesser amounts of basaltic rocks. This might account for the changes in coloration we've seen.
zh: 这份样本的玄武岩含量较低，这可能是造成我们看到颜色变化的原因。

en: The crater seems to contain materials from lower layers of the surface!
zh: 环形山中含有更深地层的成分！

en: These samples appear to be quite old compared to others we've taken.
zh: 这些样本和我们采集的其他样本相比，时间要久得多。

en: You sample the dark surface of the crater. This should help determine what type of object hit here.
zh: 你为环形山的黑色地表取样。这应该有助于判断是什么物质撞击了这里。

en: This crater seems to be filled with useful materials in high concentration. What luck!
zh: 这座环形山充满了高浓度的有用材料，运气真不错！

en: The patterning of this surface sample is particularly interesting.
zh: 这份地表样本的结构尤其有趣。

en: As you sample the crater you can't help but feel bad for the Mun. It's been beaten up pretty bad by these impacts.
zh: 为环形山取样时，你不禁为Mun感到难过。在多次冲击下，它受到了很大的损伤。

en: You dig around in the surface of the crater, looking for any rocks that look neat.
zh: 你在环形山周围的地表挖掘，寻找好看的石头。

en: You find a really cool looking rock and decide to keep it. Remembering that you're supposed to take a surface sample, you throw any old rocks you find into the container. Job done!
zh: 你找到了一块很酷的石头，决定把它带回去。然后你想起来应该收集地表样本，于是开始把自己找到的各种破石头扔进容器中。完工！

en: Yep, it's a crater all right. You've noted this down on your checklist with a smiley face. Science is fun!
zh: 没错，是环形山。你在自己的清单中画了一个笑脸标记。科学真有趣！

en: This crater seems to have been a really nasty impact, and the samples are heavier than normal.
zh: 这座环形山好像遭到过很严重的冲击，样本比正常样本更重。

en: You're glad that the Mun's gravity is so low. Digging is backbreaking work!
zh: 你很庆幸Mun的重力特别小，因为挖土是个力气活！

en: This area has a particularly high concentration of rare elements. Nice!
zh: 这个地区的稀有元素浓度很高。真棒！

en: Continual samples of this area confirm it is rich in useful materials.
zh: 这个地区连续采集的几个样本都证实其包含丰富的有用物质。

en: You dig around for a nice sample of the crater, carefully selecting a little bit of everything.
zh: 你在周围挖掘，试图找到环形山的理想样本，并仔细把每一种物质都放进来一点儿。

en: The surface seems to consist of tiny crystal-like grains. Very pretty, but probably not edible.
zh: 地表看上去是由微小的类水晶颗粒组成的。非常漂亮，但大概不能吃。

en: You sneak a taste of the surface sample... Nope, it definitely is not made of delicious dessert products.
zh: 你偷偷尝了一口表面样本…不，绝对不是用美味的甜点构成的。

en: The surface appears to have a very strong purple tint to it... or is it grey and it just looks purple because everything else on Eve is? You start to wonder if you're not taking on a purple tint yourself.
zh: 地表带有浓重的紫色…或者其实是灰色的，还是被Eve上的其他紫色物体映成了紫色？你开始怀疑自己看上去是不是也是紫色的。

en: This surface consists of a grainy, very fine, sand-like dust, and it appears to be getting everywhere.
zh: 这块地面是由一种非常精细的沙状颗粒微尘构成的，而且微尘已经飞得到处都是了。

en: There appear to be traces of water in the soil!
zh: 土壤中好像有水流的痕迹！

en: Unable to satisfy your curiousity, you attempt to drill into the rock with your tool. You're thinking it would be a lot easier if you had some kind of pulsating drill-thing on a robotic arm.
zh: 在无法满足的好奇心的驱使下，你尝试用工具钻透岩石。如果你带了冲击钻或者机械臂之类的东西，就容易多了。

en: The ground is made up of old lava flows, suggesting periods of intense volcanic activity.
zh: 地面由古老的岩浆流构成，意味着曾有剧烈的火山活动。

en: The surface gives away easily and you have a hard time keeping the sample in the container due to the low gravity.
zh: 地表很容易就被挖开了，但由于重力很低，把样本装到容器里反而费了你不少力气。

en: The composition of elements is very similar to that of an asteroid.
zh: 元素的成分和小行星很相近。

en: The Dark black soil has an almost crystalline structure. It's fun to play with.
zh: 黑色土壤似乎具有一种晶体结构，真好玩。

en: The white soil has a powdery texture and clumps together.
zh: 白色土壤是粉末质地的，并且能够凝聚成团。

en: You find traces of a large number of elements, likely deposited here by impacts over time.
zh: 你发现了大量元素的痕迹，可能是被一次次的撞击散播在这里的。

en: After digging around for a bit, you find some nice bits of glass and throw them in your sample container.
zh: 在周围挖了一阵子以后，你找到了一些漂亮的玻璃碎片，并把它们扔进了你的样本瓶。

en: The soil sample contains traces of salt. You wonder if it has blown here, or if this area was once under water.
zh: 这里的土壤样本有盐的痕迹。你开始猜测盐是被风刮来的，还是这里本来在水面下。

en: You chip away the frozen surface and deposit some of the blue surface material into a container.
zh: 你把结冻的地面凿开，将一些蓝色的地面物质放进了容器。

en: You dig around in the surface and find some beautiful green and blue crystal structures. They remind you a bit of home, but you're unable to pick out Kerbin from the mass of twinkling lights.
zh: 你在表面挖了几下，找到了一些漂亮的绿色和蓝色晶体结构，让你想起了自己的母星。但在闪亮的光芒中，你辨认不出Kerbin的样子。

en: The ground gives way easily, but the surface underneath is much harder.
zh: 地面很容易挖开，但下面的地层就坚硬多了。

en: You hum a little tune while you work to make the time pass faster. Tylo has some really interesting rocks!
zh: 你一边工作，一边哼着歌打发时间。Tylo有很多非常有意思的岩石！

en: The brown dust stains all the parts of your suit that it comes in contact with. This is apparently quite amusing to flight control.
zh: 你的衣服上所有接触到棕色灰尘的地方都被弄脏了。飞行控制中心的那帮家伙显然觉得这很搞笑。

en: You dig through the surface and find a little sphere. It looks a bit like an egg.
zh: 你挖开表层，找到了一个小圆球。看上去有点儿像一个蛋。

en: As you shovel the contents into a container, you can't help but feel you'll be allergic to whatever it is.
zh: 把内容物挖到容器里时，你不禁感到自己搞不好会对这种东西过敏。

en: The sample is the same odd mottle of colors as the planet from orbit. You check off a little box on your list.
zh: 样本带有奇怪的斑纹，和在轨道上看这颗行星的样子一样。你给自己的列表上的一个小格子打上了对勾。

en: After conducting samples of the surface, you determine with a high certainty that Pol is not, in fact, made of Pollen. This will cause quite the stir back home!
zh: 在地表取样完成后，你几乎可以确定Pol是由花粉构成的。这一定会引起轰动的！

en: Chipping away at the icy surface, you find some brown soil underneath.
zh: 凿开结冰的地面后，你发现下面有棕色的土壤。

en: You find a beautiful crystal and place it in the sample container.
zh: 你找到一块漂亮的水晶，将其放进了样本盒。

en: The rocks contain thin wisps of color. They remind you of lovely ION exhaust trails...
zh: 这儿的岩石带有淡淡的颜色。让你想起了漂亮的离子火箭尾迹。

en: You exposed the material samples to the environment, taking notes of how it behaves.
zh: 你将材料样本暴露在环境中，记录其反应。

en: Everything is melting, including the electronicsssss.........
zh: 所有东西都在融化，包括电子子子子子…

en: The materials bay bakes in the heat of Moho's surface. It appears that trace elements are reacting to the samples contained within.
zh: 材料舱沐浴在Moho表面的高温中，微量元素开始和其内部的样本发生反应。

en: You expose the samples to the high temperatures of Moho. A lot of them melt in really interesting ways.
zh: 你将样本暴露在Moho的高温中，很多样本开始发生有趣的融化。

en: The materials show little signs of change, though one of the samples appears to be judging you silently.
zh: 这些材料基本没有变化，尽管有一个好像在默默鄙视着你。

en: The desert dust appears to have contaminated all the samples. We did learn that deserts aren't a good place to bring expensive science equipment, though!
zh: 沙漠尘埃污染了所有样本。不过我们还是学到了东西，那就是不要把昂贵的科学装备带到沙漠里！

en: The water sample has frozen solid and the goopy samples appear to be extra goopy.
zh: 水体样本已经冻成了固体，黏性物样本变得更黏了。

en: The water spray has rusted one of the samples and some of the electronics ar&/F***13e5rse4t8st######
zh: 水雾让一个样本生锈了，有些电器也&/F***13e5rse4t8st######

en: Everything has gotten really wet. One of the samples caught fire! Whoa!
zh: 所有东西都弄湿了，有一个样本着火了！哇哦！

en: Exposing the power source of the lab to water has proved to be rather... enlightening.
zh: 事实证明，将实验室的电源插座泡在水里的后果十分…令人震撼。

en: You expose the samples to the badlands of Kerbin, but worry that it may have a bad influence on them.
zh: 你把样本暴露在Kerbin荒地上，这会让人有些担心这会对它们造成负面影响。

en: The less resilient samples appear to have splattered around the interior, forming new and interesting color combinations.
zh: 耐受度较低的样本在内部喷溅，形成了新的有趣颜色组合。

en: The rarified air has caused interesting changes to the gel samples. It seems like something is happening with the interior structure.
zh: 稀薄的空气使胶体样本发生了有趣的变化，内部结构仿佛有了一些变动。

en: The micro gravity has greatly affected the growth of crystalline structures. Loose objects are also flying around the bay in a very messy but fascinating way.
zh: 微重力环境大大影响了晶体结构的成长。松散的物体以混乱而惊人的方式在舱内漂浮。

en: The fine dust of the Mun has intermixed with some of the samples. You have a sneaking suspicion that they'll never be able to get the lab clean again.
zh: Mun的微尘混入了一些样本，你开始偷偷怀疑，他们是不是永远不可能再把实验室清理干净了。

en: You leave the sample bay doors open on the Mun, and go do something else for a while.
zh: 你在Mun上离开样本舱去做其他事情，没有关门。

en: While the material samples were processed, you began to turn your thoughts to how much Minmus looks like a mint dessert, and have discovered that you are now hungry.
zh: 在处理材料样本时，你开始想Minmus看上去很像一份薄荷甜点，然后发现自己饿了。

en: The high radiation environment caused a few of the samples to glow. It looks like it would be fun to paint the rocket with this.
zh: 高辐射环境下，一些样本开始发光。如果用这些给火箭涂装，一定很有趣。

en: The crushing pressure of the atmosphere is causing some of the materials to crystallize rapidly.
zh: 大气中的巨大压力让一些材料开始迅速结晶化。

en: You're not sure if most of the samples changed color, or if it's just the lighting...
zh: 你不能确定是大部分样本都开始变色，还是因为光线原因。

en: The extremely dense atmosphere strips the contents of the materials bay.
zh: 极度浓稠的大气将材料舱的内容物悉数摧毁。

en: The atmosphere appears to either polish or strip the material, depending on its composition.
zh: 看来大气会将材料打磨一新或是彻底摧毁，取决于其构成元素。

en: The samples appear to behave like they're in low orbit of Kerbin.
zh: 样本的运动方式就像是在Kerbin近地轨道上一样。

en: Some of the surface material has mixed with the contents of the bay. You write down the results for good measure.
zh: 有些表面物质与舱内的其他物品混合到一起，你把混合结果记录了下来，做为附加内容。

en: Opening the sample container you find that everything has turned red. Initial tests show that it'll never wash out of white space suits. You consider sending missions in pink EVA suits to reduce cleaning costs.
zh: 打开样本盒，你发现所有东西都变成了红色。初始试验表明，白色航天服上沾了这种东西是永远也洗不干净的。你开始考虑穿粉色EVA航天服进行任务，以降低清理成本。

en: The sample computer processes the results. It's massive red eye seems to be at home here as it slowly, ominously, blinks.
zh: 样本计算机对结果进行了处理。它那巨大的红色眼睛仿佛感到很自在，向你慢慢地眨一下，充满了不祥的气息。

en: One of the samples has reacted very strangely to the surface of Ike.
zh: 一个样本和Ike地表的反应很奇怪。

en: One of the crystal samples explodes and throws green shards out of the materials bay!
zh: 一个晶体样本爆炸了，绿色的碎片从材料舱中飞了出来！

en: As the samples process, the computer asks if it can sing you a song while it works. Apparently the song is about a flower of some kind.
zh: 处理样本时，计算机问你能不能一边工作一边给你唱歌。显然，这是一首关于某种花朵的歌。

en: One of the samples evaporates when exposed the environment.
zh: 一个样本接触到环境后蒸发了。

en: The computer gave an odd report no matter how many times we sent the request. Open the sample bay doors... "I'm sorry, I'm afraid I can't let you do that," was the only reply. The doors did open very promptly, however, when we opened the fusebox panel. Very curious.
zh: 无论我们发出多少次请求，电脑返回的都是一份奇怪的报告。打开样本舱的门…“很抱歉，恐怕我不能允许你那样做。”是仅有的回应。但我们打开保险丝盒的时候，门确实开了一下。很奇怪。

en: The intense, crushing pressure has drastically changed the composition of the materials. Super heating and ablation effects have been observed. The science bay is looking very disgruntled.
zh: 巨大的压力使材料的结构发生了显著改变。我们观测到了过热和烧蚀现象。科学舱看上去十分不满。

en: The samples burn, boil, or crumple under the extreme pressures and heat. The visual camera shows a wonderful rainbow of colors before it cuts out.
zh: 样本在极端压力和温度下燃烧、沸腾或皱成一团。视觉摄像头被切断前，显现出美丽的彩虹色。

en: You're not sure where the container stops and the samples start anymore...
zh: 你无法确定哪里是容器，哪里是样本了…

en: One of the samples burns on contact with the atmosphere. Interestingly, the color indicates the presence of oxygen.
zh: 一个样本接触到大气后开始燃烧。有趣的是，火苗的颜色证明其中含有氧。

en: The sample smolders and pops as it burns up.
zh: 样本在燃烧时发出爆裂声。

en: The fine, particulate sand of Laythe blows into the sample bay.
zh: Laythe细密的沙粒吹进了样本舱。

en: The sample bay power supply begins to short out! Electricity arcs and etches into the samples of the bay. It's quite the display!
zh: 样本舱供电系统发生了短路！电弧击打着舱内的样本，留下了烧焦的痕迹。真是精彩！

en: Many of the samples either freeze or evaporate from the sample container.
zh: 很多样本在容器中结冻或蒸发了。

en: The container sample door freezes up, before finally continuing to open. A thin coating forms on the surface of the samples.
zh: 容器的样本舱门冻住了，随后终于又打开了。样本的表面形成了一层薄霜。

en: One of the samples shatters into a fine mist when exposed to the surface of Tylo.
zh: 一个样本暴露在Tylo地表后，碎成了微尘。

en: The samples appear to be having a chemical reaction with the surface of Bop.
zh: 样本和Bop地表发生了化学反应。

en: All of the liquid samples instantly evaporate.
zh: 所有液体样本瞬间蒸发了。

en: Some of the samples pit and melt when they come in contact with the surface of Pol!
zh: 有些样本接触到Pol表面后凹陷并融化了！

en: Some of the fine crystals lining Eeloo enter the materials bay. It also appears that some of the samples have become more conductive in the extreme cold.
zh: Eeloo的细微晶体进入了材料舱。有些样本在极度低温中传导性变强了。

en: Collected and recorded temperature data from the environment.
zh: 已收集并记录环境温度数据。

en: Temperature readings are quite literally, nominal.
zh: 温度读数确实若有若无。

en: Large plumes of heat are rising from the surface of the desert.
zh: 沙漠表面升腾起一股股热浪。

en: It's cold enough to freeze water solid.
zh: 温度足以让水结冰。

en: Just the right temperature to go for a swim.
zh: 温度很适合游泳。

en: The water appears to get colder as the depth increases.
zh: 水温随着深度增加而降低。

en: It's cold enough to keep things permanently frozen here.
zh: 这里的温度低到足以永久保持冰冻状态。

en: The temperature here is quite pleasant, and would be a nice place to live.
zh: 这里的温度颇为宜人，应该很适合居住。

en: the temperature appears to fluctuate here a good bit, depending on the time of day.
zh: 这里的温度在一天中不同时段内会大幅波动。

en: The temperature is very high and appears to fluctuate to extremes in the sunlight.
zh: 温度非常高，在阳光照射下会达到极端高温。

en: Temperatures range between very cold and hot enough to boil water.
zh: 温度在极度寒冷和沸水高温之间波动。

en: Measuring the temperature of space appears to be quite impossible, as there is no matter around to be either hot or cold... except the spacecraft, and the thermometer itself. This is probably going to give the R&D guys something to think about for a while.
zh: 测量太空温度看似不可能，因为除了太空飞船和温度计本身，四周不存在或冷或热的物质。这大概够研发部门的家伙们思考一阵子的了。

en: Collected and recorded atmospheric pressure data from the surroundings.
zh: 已收集并记录周围大气压数据。

en: The barometer reading is too low to measure. This planet has no atmosphere.
zh: 气压计读数过低，无法测量。这颗行星没有大气。

en: The barometer is still reading nothing.
zh: 气压计仍然没有读数。

en: The atmospheric pressure is very high, even at this altitude.
zh: 大气压非常高，就算在这种高度也是一样。

en: The atmosphere is very dense at the surface. It crushes down on the instrumentation.
zh: 表面大气十分浓稠，把仪器都压坏了。

en: Either the instruments are broken, or there is no atmosphere on this rock.
zh: 要么是仪器坏了，要么就是这块大石头上没有大气。

en: You think that you have a reading for a second, but nope; it was just a smudge on the gauge.
zh: 你以为自己在一瞬间看到了读数，其实没有，那只是表盘上的一个污点。

en: Just for kicks you measure the pressure here. Yep, no atmosphere.
zh: 你量了这里的气压，只是因为无聊。没错，没有气压。

en: The pressure gauge is sitting there motionless. Perhaps you should tap it a few times to be sure?
zh: 气压计一动不动。也许你应该拍它几下，确认没有问题？

en: They say insanity is doing the same thing multiple times and expecting a different result. You check the atmospheric pressure again anyways.
zh: 人们说，疯狂就是不断重复同一件事，并期待不同的结果。不过你还是再检查一下大气读数。

en: The atmosphere is very thin here, but it is enough to register on the instrumentation.
zh: 这里的大气很稀薄，但足以被仪器读出。

en: The atmosphere is pretty thin even at the surface. You don't think parachutes or wings would work very well here.
zh: 即使在地表，大气也很稀薄。你不觉得降落伞或机翼能在这里工作。

en: There appears to be no atmosphere here.
zh: 这里好像没有大气。

en: The gauge reads nothing, even on the surface.
zh: 即使是在地面，仪表盘也没有读数。

en: The pressures here are immense. The instrument is beginning to fail.
zh: 这里的气压太大，仪器开始出现故障。

en: The pressures are very high. It seems dangerous to probe any deeper.
zh: 气压非常高，继续深入探测可能会发生危险。

en: Either the pressure is really high, or the instrument just melted. It's hard to tell what happened first.
zh: 要么是气压太高，要么就是仪器刚刚融化了。不知道哪件事是先发生的。

en: There is definitely an atmosphere. Pressures are fairly nominal.
zh: 这儿肯定有大气，读数非常显著。

en: The pressures here seem to be a bit below that of Kerbin, but definitely at a manageable level.
zh: 这里的气压好像比Kerbin低一些，但绝对能够测量。

en: There does not appear to be any atmosphere to sample.
zh: 这里没有可供取样的大气。

en: Gasses rising for the planet appear to occasionally register slight pressures. Either that, or the instrument is on the fritz.
zh: 从行星冒出来的气体偶尔能带来微弱的气压，要么就是是仪器出现故障了。

en: Just to be sure, you check the pressure a few times. You think you saw the gauge move a bit.
zh: 为了确认，你又量了几次气压，并认为自己看到指针动了一下。

en: Surprisingly, you discover no traces of atmosphere.
zh: 出乎意料的是，你没有发现任何大气的痕迹。

en: There is no detectable atmospheric pressure here. Fascinating!
zh: 这里没有可以感知到的气压。了不起！

en: It's a giant space rock. What did you expect to find?
zh: 一块巨大的太空岩石。你以为自己会发现什么？

en: Still nothing. Definitely just a space rock.
zh: 这什么都没有。就是一块太空岩石。

en: Nothing to report here.
zh: 没有什么值得回报的。

en: No atmospheric pressure is detectable on Pol.
zh: Pol没有可以测量到的大气压。

en: Beep, beep, beep... boop. The instrument has frozen up.
zh: 嘀，嘀，嘀…嘟。仪器冻住了。

en: The instrument can't register any pressure here.
zh: 仪器无法在这里读到任何压强。

en: Atmospheric pressure reads zero! This most assuredly indicates we must be in space now!
zh: 气压读数为零！这是能够证明我们进入太空的明确证据！

en: There seems to be no atmosphere at all this far away from home. You find this strangely meaningful.
zh: 在离母星这么远的地方，根本没有大气。你有一种莫名的感慨。

en: The instrument reads zero. It's as if it were in a vacuum!
zh: 仪器读数为零。就像在真空里一样！

en: Gathered precise acceleration data while subjecting the vessel to this situation.
zh: 在调整航天器适应当前状况的同时收集到了精确的加速度数据。

en: The sensor detects vibrations deep inside the planet. It appears that the interior is very volcanically active.
zh: 传感器检测到了行星深处的震动。行星内部仿佛在发生剧烈的火山运动。

en: Odd reflections are detected in the recorded vibrations. This might tell us more about the interior structure.
zh: 震动记录中出现了奇怪的反应，可能透露更多行星内部结构的信息。

en: The sensor has detected possible seismic activity below the surface.
zh: 传感器检测到了地表下可能存在地震活动。

en: The vibrations, though slight, might be enough to map the interior structure of the planet.
zh: 尽管震动很轻微，但可能足以用于探测行星的内部结构。

en: This area appears to be seismically dead.
zh: 这片区域好像没有地震活动。

en: The only vibrations we detect are coming from the landing craft. The vibrations do not travel well through the surface.
zh: 我们唯一检测到的震动是来自飞船着陆。震动在地表的传导不是很强。

en: The sensor has detected a minor quake on the surface!
zh: 传感器检测到地表发生了小型地震！

en: The sensor picks up distant impacts on the surface, reflecting along the interior of the Mun.
zh: 传感器识别到了地层深处对地表的冲击，能够反映出Mun的内部结构。

en: Faint seismic waves are detected.
zh: 检测到微弱的地震波。

en: Sounds of shifting and vibration are detected under the surface. It is possible that the interior is not completely frozen.
zh: 检测到地表下方有板块移动和震动声，有可能内部没有完全冻结。

en: The sensor gives insight into the seismic activity of Duna.
zh: 传感器提供了Duna内部地震活动的情况。

en: There does not appear to be significant seismic activity on the planet. It is possible that it is no longer geologically active.
zh: 这颗星球上没有明显的地震活动，有可能在地质上不再处于活跃状态。

en: This planet appears to be seismically inactive.
zh: 这颗星球没有地震活动。

en: periodic bombardments appear to be causing slight vibrations and surface quakes.
zh: 周期性的撞击引起了轻微震动和表层地震。

en: Changes in the speed of vibrations hint to differing materials under the surface.
zh: 震动速度的变化暗示着地表下的不同物质。

en: The sensor doesn't even know what to do with itself here.
zh: 传感器甚至不知道自己在这里能干些什么。

en: The sensor has informed you that the warranty has just been voided. No refunds.
zh: 传感器通知你，保修刚刚失效了。不能退款。

en: Tidal forces appear to be churning the interior of the moon.
zh: 行星内部像是有潮汐力不停起伏。

en: Vibrations under the surface indicate current geological activity.
zh: 地表下的震动显示当前地质活动的情况。

en: Sensors detect signs of cryovolcanism along the surface.
zh: 传感器检测到沿地表的冰火山。

en: The sensor picks up vibrations reflecting around the interior of the moon.
zh: 传感器捕捉到了围绕在卫星内部周围的震动回响。

en: The moon appears to be largely inactive.
zh: 卫星看上去非常不活跃。

en: The sensor records even the slightest surface vibration.
zh: 即使是最轻微的表面震动，也会被传感器记录下来。

en: There does not appear to be any major seismic activity on Bop.
zh: Bop没有任何显著的地震活动。

en: A seismic event is detected in the distance, as if a large object had just impacted the surface.
zh: 检测到远方发生地震活动，可能是大型物体撞击地表造成。

en: The loose soil transmits vibration differently than on other bodies.
zh: 松软的土壤传导震动的方式与其他地质构造不同。

en: Vibrations reflect off the jagged structures inside the moon.
zh: 震动能反映出卫星内部的粗糙结构。

en: Cryovolcanic activity is detected in the interior of the planet.
zh: 在行星内部检测到冰火山活动。

en: The sensor picks up low frequency sounds.
zh: 传感器捕捉到低频音波。

en: Recorded accurate measurements of gravitational forces in these conditions.
zh: 已精确记录上述情况下的重力测量结果。

en: The sensor passes over the terrain of Moho surveying for variances in the gravitational field.
zh: 传感器扫描Moho地表，调查重力场变化情况。

en: Landing here has provided a very accurate and stable measure of gravitational forces.
zh: 在这里降落提供了非常精确和稳定的重力测量基础。

en: The sensor records slight variances in gravity as you pass over a massive crater site.
zh: 当你经过一片巨大的环形山脉时，传感器记录下了轻微的重力变化。

en: The gravitational field is very strong here. The sensor records detailed data about the local field.
zh: 这里的重力场很强。传感器记录下了详细的本地重力场数据。

en: The sensor picks up the fluctuations in the gravity of this lumpy body.
zh: 传感器捕捉到了这颗凹凸不平的星球上的重力波动。

en: The team back at KSC will enjoy these detailed readings.
zh: KSC的团队会很喜欢这些详细读数的。

en: The sensor finds subtle changes in the gravity field of Kerbin. The science team will want to see these readings!
zh: 传感器发现Kerbin的重力场发生了微小变化。科学小组肯定想看到这些数据！

en: The sensor seems to think it's being calibrated.
zh: 传感器仿佛感到自己正接受校准。

en: After reading the manual a few times, the command team is able to take an accurate reading of the local gravity.
zh: 读了几遍手册以后，机组人员就能够获取本地重力的精确读数了。

en: The instrument surveys the gravity over the grasslands. It appears the field is very stable here.
zh: 这台仪器会测量草原上的重力。这里的重力看上去很稳定。

en: The instrument surveys the highlands of Kerbin. The rolling hills seem to affect local gravity slightly.
zh: 这台仪器会测量Kerbin高原上的重力。区域重力场会受到连绵山峰的轻微影响。

en: The field appears to be strongest along these mountain ranges.
zh: 这里的重力场是这片山区中最强的。

en: The dunes appear to have a very stable gravitation, though some spikes would indicate the underground terrain varies in composition.
zh: 沙丘的重力十分稳定，但一些凸起点显示地下的地质组成有所不同。

en: The sensor reads the gravity over the badlands of Kerbin.
zh: 传感器读取Kerbin荒地的重力。

en: The sensor detects variances under the surface of the ice. Is there a landmass under that ice?
zh: 传感器检测到冰面下的读数变化。难道冰下有陆地？

en: The sensor passes over the shores of Kerbin. The readings appear to be nominal.
zh: 传感器扫过Kerbin海岸，读数好像没有显著变化。

en: The sensor shows a surprising variance as it passes over the oceans, hinting at the varied topography deep below the waters.
zh: 在扫描海洋时，传感器读数出现了令人惊讶的变化，显示水面下的海底地貌千变万化。

en: The sensor has detected changes in the local gravity that seem to be related to the passing of the Mun.
zh: 传感器检测到区域重力变化，可能与Mun经过有关。

en: The instrument surveys for changes in the gravity field of the Mun. This data will help to accurately calculate the mass of the body.
zh: 这台仪器会测量Mun重力场的变化。得到的数据有助于精确计算星球的质量。

en: The sensor conducts a detailed survey of the local gravity.
zh: 传感器对区域重力进行了详细调查。

en: After calibration, the sensor is able to detect the interplay of gravity between Kerbin and the Mun.
zh: 校准后，传感器能够检测到Kerbin和Mun之间的重力作用。

en: Passing over the surface, the sensor sweeps across the gravitational field of Minmus.
zh: 通过表面时，传感器扫描了Minmus的重力场。

en: The sensor takes detailed readings of the local gravity on Minmus.
zh: 传感器详细记录了Minmus的区域重力。

en: The scan picks up the subtle changes in field caused by the orbit of the Mun. This data will provide valuable insight into the local planetary system.
zh: 扫描结果捕捉到了由Mun轨道造成的微弱重力场变化。这些数据对分析区域行星间系统会很有价值。

en: The sensor passes over the mottled surface of Duna. Gravity appears lowest in the massive canyon that stretches across the surface.
zh: 传感器扫过Duna斑驳的地表。重力最低的区域是横跨地面的大峡谷。

en: The sensor performs a detailed and calibrated sweep of the local gravity on Duna.
zh: 传感器对Duna的区域重力进行了详细而准确的扫描。

en: The sensor is able to record the affects of Ike as it orbits Duna.
zh: 传感器记录下了Ike围绕Duna运动时所受的影响。

en: The sensor sweeps the surface and finds the average gravitational pull to be quite low for a planet.
zh: 传感器扫过地表，发现作为一颗行星，这里的平均重力很低。

en: The sensor measures the local gravity in fine detail and records all variations.
zh: 传感器以高精度测量了区域重力，并记录下了全部变化。

en: The sensor recalibrates to measure the massive gravitational forces of Jool.
zh: 传感器进行重新校准，以适应Jool的巨大重力。

en: The sensor picks up a wealth of information about the local planetary system.
zh: 传感器收集了大量该区域卫星系统的信息。

en: The instrument has been crushed by the massive gravitational forces. Science!
zh: 这台仪器在巨大的重力下崩溃了。科学的力量啊！

en: The sensor scans the gravity of Laythe. It hints at diverse terrain under the water.
zh: 传感器扫描Laythe的重力，显示水面下有多种地形。

en: The sensor scans the local gravity of Laythe, recording the influence of Jool.
zh: 传感器扫描Laythe的区域重力，记录下Jool的影响。

en: The sensor provides detailed gravity information in relation to the tides.
zh: 传感器提供与潮汐相关的详细重力信息。

en: Scanning from orbit provides a clearer picture of the internal makeup of Vall.
zh: 轨道扫描提供了更清晰的Vall内部构成图景。

en: Scanning the surface details gravitational fluctuations in the shifting interior of the planet.
zh: 扫描地表提供了行星内部运动时详细的重力波动信息。

en: The planet has lower gravity than anticipated. This will give our scientists information about the interior makeup of Tylo.
zh: 这颗行星的重力比预期来得低，为我们的科学家提供了关于Tylo内部构成的信息。

en: Detailed scans hint at hollow spaces in the interior of the planet.
zh: 详细扫描显示，行星内部存在空洞。

en: Orbiting Bop allows for scans of the varied surface. Interesting stuff!
zh: 绕Bop轨道运转能够扫描到这里变化的地表。有意思！

en: The sensor is giving odd readings here...
zh: 传感器出现了奇怪的读数…

en: The sensor picks up multiple layers under the surface of the planet.
zh: 传感器捕捉到了行星地表下的多层构造。

en: Landing on the planet has allowed for highly detailed scans of the interior gravity on Pol.
zh: 降落在行星上之后，可以对Pol内部重力进行详细扫描。

en: Though the surface appears to be smooth, there are fluctuations under the surface of the planet.
zh: 尽管表面看上去很平滑，这颗行星的表面之下存在着波动。

en: Gravity scans are very clear here. There appears to be little influence from other bodies.
zh: 重力扫描结果很清晰。几乎没有受到其他星球的影响。

en: You run an atmospheric analysis, recording various measurements like temperature, pressure and atmospheric composition.
zh: 你可以进行大气层分析并记录不同读数，包括温度、压力和大气成分。

en: There appears to be no atmosphere here, though there are trace elements being detected close to the surface.
zh: 这里好像没有大气层，但在地表附近检测到了微量元素。

en: This might be an atmosphere, but it's definitely not something you want to breathe.
zh: 这里可能有大气层，但肯定不能用来呼吸。

en: There is no detectable atmosphere.
zh: 这里没有能检测的大气层。

en: It seems there is very little atmosphere at these altitudes. Make sure you're properly suited up if you plan on going outside.
zh: 在这个高度好像没有大气层。如果你想出去，一定要穿好装备。

en: Temperature and Pressure readings suggest today is as good a time for flying as any.
zh: 温度和压力读数显示，今天和其他日子一样适合飞行。

en: It's very hot and dry out in the Deserts. The sensors were getting clogged up with dust.
zh: 沙漠里十分炎热干燥，传感器被灰尘堵住了。

en: The polar atmosphere was found to be very, very cold indeed. Some sensors froze shut, but we're reasonably sure this is still air.
zh: 两极的大气非常非常寒冷，有些传感器被冻得关闭了，但我们有理由相信仍然有大气存在。

en: Instruments detect a faint particulate aura around the surface. Not an atmosphere, but it may explain the reported lights on the horizon.
zh: 仪器检测到地表存在微弱的微粒层，虽然不是大气层，但也许能够解释报告中记录的地平线亮光。

en: There are detectable releases of gasses, but nothing that could be considered an atmosphere.
zh: 检测到了气体释放，但没有能称得上大气层的东西。

en: The atmosphere on Duna is very, very thin. It might be possible to fly in it with large enough wings, or a fast enough aircraft.
zh: Duna的大气非常、非常稀薄。如果机翼够大，或是飞得够快，也许能在那儿飞行。

en: There appears to be a larger concentration of heavy isotopes in the atmosphere than on Kerbin.
zh: 这里的大气层中重同位素的浓度比Kerbin来得大。

en: You run an analysis on the non-existent atmosphere.
zh: 你对怕是不存在了的大气进行了分析。

en: There does not appear to be an atmosphere here.
zh: 这里不存在大气层。

en: The atmospheric pressures are very high here, and you detect a large number of gasses.
zh: 这里的大气压力很大，你检测到了大量气体。

en: The instrument is having trouble sampling at these densities. The gasses are beginning to liquify under pressure.
zh: 仪器无法在当前浓度下采样，气体在压力下已经开始液化。

en: The instrument has mostly compressed into an unrecognizable mass of metal.
zh: 这台仪器基本被压成了一团无法辨认的金属。

en: The atmosphere on Laythe appears to be very similar to that of Kerbin. I wouldn't volunteer to go out first without a helmet on, however.
zh: Laythe的大气层看上去和Kerbin十分相似，不过我可不想当第一个摘下头盔的人。

en: Taking your helmet off here probably won't kill you... very quickly.
zh: 在这里摘掉头盔可能不会有生命危险…至少不会马上就有。。

en: There are traces of cryovolcanic compounds. But not a full atmosphere.
zh: 这里有冰火山化合物的痕迹，但没有完整的大气层。

en: There appear to be only faint traces of the heaviest isotopes on the surface.
zh: 地表好像只有最重的同位素的微弱痕迹。

en: The sensors detected organic compounds for a second. Possibly a mistake.
zh: 传感器在一瞬间检测到了有机化合物，也许是误读。

en: The sensors detect nothing out of the ordinary. Surely nothing could live here.
zh: 传感器没有检测到任何常规之外的物质，这里不可能有生命。

en: There is no atmosphere to speak of, but you sample the temperature anyways.
zh: 这里没有值得一提的大气，不过你依然可以测量温度。

en: There appears to be a tenuous atmospheric coating around the planet. But it is too thin to affect any spacecraft landing here.
zh: 这颗行星周围好像有一层稀薄的大气，但由于浓度很低，所以不会影响在这里着陆的飞船。

en: You collect a sample of the asteroid.
zh: 你收集了一份小行星样本。

en: You collect a sample while the asteroid is high over Kerbin.
zh: 你在小行星离Kerbin很远的时候收集了一份样本。

en: You collect a sample as the asteroid orbits close to Kerbin.
zh: 你在小行星轨道贴近Kerbin的时候收集了一份样本。

en: You collect a sample of the asteroid inside Kerbin's atmosphere.
zh: 你在小行星进入Kerbin大气层的时候收集了一份样本。

en: As a consequence of a somewhat worse than average accident at [Agency], we've been forced to look for some outside help.
zh: 由于[Agency]内的事故率高于平均水平，我们被迫寻求外部帮助。

en: While working late nights, the scientists at [Agency] have made a startling discovery.
zh: [Agency]的科学家深夜加班时，有了一个惊人的发现。

en: While cleaning up after an unintended ignition, one of the overworked teams at [Agency] raised an interesting question.
zh: 在清理意外失火的现场时，[Agency]的一组加班过度的员工提出了一个有趣的问题。

en: The board of directors at [Agency] have raised some troubling issues.
zh: [Agency]的董事会提出了一些麻烦的问题。

en: The CEO (and chief bottle washer) at [Agency] has stumbled on a problem.
zh: [Agency]的CEO（兼首席试管清洗员）遇到了一个问题。

en: The number of times we've achieved sudden combustion at [Agency] has lead us to consider something.
zh: 在[Agency]内发生的多次突发自燃事件让我们开始思考一个问题。

en: At [Agency], we're not afraid to try new things. As a result, we sometimes find ourselves in the situation of needing outside help to solve a problem.
zh: 在[Agency]，我们不害怕尝试新事物。结果呢，有时我们会为了解决一个问题，而需要寻求外部帮助。

en: We've got some pretty impressive rock collections at [Agency].
zh: 我们在[Agency]收集了很多令人惊叹的岩石。

en: [Agency] can think of nothing more prestigious than taking a Kerbal, and leaving them behind on another world.
zh: [Agency]想不到有什么事能比把一个坎巴拉人送到另一个世界，然后将其留在那还更光荣的事情了。

en: We have the finest scientific minds working at [Agency], and we've been thinking about giving them something to do.
zh: 世界上最出色的科学家都在[Agency]工作，而我们一直在考虑应该让他们干点儿什么。

en: The research department at [Agency] is very close to figuring out a unified theory of gravioli.
zh: [Agency]的研发中心很快就要提出关于引力子的统一理论了。

en: At [Agency], we need brave Kerbals with the right stuff to help achieve our dreams.
zh: 在[Agency]，我们需要具备勇敢的坎巴拉人帮助我们实现梦想。

en: One of the founding principles of [Agency] is to continue to advance the frontiers of science.
zh: [Agency]的基础原则之一就是不断拓展科学的最前线。

en: While hitting parts with a wrench, the engineers at [Agency] realized we had a problem.
zh: 在用扳手敲打部件的时候，[Agency]的工程师发现我们碰到了一个问题。

en: We've been reviewing our product catalog at [Agency] and have found an oversight.
zh: 我们在检查[Agency]的产品目录时，发现了一处疏忽。

en: We're very proud of our flag at [Agency], and wanted to do something special with it.
zh: 在[Agency]，我们为自己的旗帜而自豪，并且想用它做一些特别的事情。

en: As part of [Agency]'s commitment to strong corporate statements, we've been looking for ways to get our brand out there.
zh: 作为[Agency]成为强大公司的目标的一部分，我们一直在寻找推广品牌的方法。

en: At [Agency], we're Kerbal enough to admit when mistakes are made. This is one of those times.
zh: 在[Agency]，我们像真正的坎巴拉人一样，敢于承认自己所犯的错误。现在就是这样一个时刻。

en: We're not usually in the habit of misplacing things at [Agency], but we may have lost something big.
zh: [Agency]一般不会出现随便乱放物品的现象，但这次我们可能弄丢了重要的东西。

en: We're constantly looking for how to make better use of satellites at [Agency].
zh: 在[Agency]，我们一直在寻找更好地利用卫星的方式。

en: As a result of some surplus parts at the [Agency] warehouses, we've got some more opportunities for orbital satellites.
zh: 由于[Agency]仓库内有很多多余部件，我们的轨道卫星获得了更多的机会。

en: To meet our quota of "useful things in space", we've been looking into station building projects at [Agency].
zh: 为了达成我们的口号“太空中的有用之物”，[Agency]一直在研究空间站建设项目。

en: We've been poring over maps at the [Agency] offices looking for points of interest, and may have come up with something.
zh: 我们一直在[Agency]办公室的地图中寻找有意思的地方，现在可能有所发现了。

en: While using the [Agency] dart board as a waypoint planner, we've come up with something interesting.
zh: 在把[Agency]的飞镖盘用作路径规划图时，我们想到了一件有趣的事情。

en: We're always looking for new revenue streams at [Agency]. Our accountants have told us that space tourism is a growth industry and we'd like to get in on it.
zh: [Agency]总是在寻找新的资金流。我们的会计告诉我们，太空旅行是一个正在发展的行业，而我们想进入这个行业。

en: We may have underestimated just how volatile solid rocket fuel really is, and have now found ourselves with a problem we can't solve on our own.
zh: 我们可能低估了固体火箭燃料的挥发性，因此现在我们正面临着一个我们自己无法解决的问题。

en: To test out some of our more advanced theories, we need more debris in low orbit.
zh: 为了验证我们的一些更高深的理论，我们需要更多在近地轨道的残骸。

en: We're not sure if there really is such a thing as too many struts, but we'd like to find out.
zh: 我们不确定钢筋的数量是否有上限，但我们想试试看。

en: We're trying to figure out if all matter in the universe is as dense as on Kerbin, but haven't come up with a conclusive test for it.
zh: 我们想搞清楚是否宇宙中的所有物质都和Kerbin的一样稠密，但还没想出最终的验证方法。

en: We want to know what shades of green we'll see if we expose a Kerbal to high gee forces.
zh: 我们想知道当坎巴拉人暴露在高G力环境下时，会呈现出什么色调的绿色。

en: There are fewer asteroids in orbit of [Topic] than the standard model would predict.
zh: [Topic]轨道中的小行星数量比标准模型的预测值要少。

en: We believe that an asteroid in orbit of [Topic] is worth two in space, and would like to prove it.
zh: 我们认为[Topic]轨道中的一颗小行星的研究价值相当于两颗，并且我们想验证这个理论。

en: We'd like to run some experiments on the feasibility of long-term Kerbal habitation outside of Kerbin as part of the [Topic] project.
zh: 作为[Topic]项目的一部分，我们想就坎巴拉人在Kerbin以外的地区长期居住的可行性进行一些试验。

en: We need someone to apply the scientific method... in space!
zh: 我们需要有人实践科学方法…在太空里！

en: We're looking for some scientific data. We'd really prefer some new data, but we'd be really happy with any data at all, really.
zh: 我们需要一些科学数据。最好是新数据，不过其实任何数据都可以。

en: We have some forms to fill out, and we're pretty sure it would be way more interesting if we filled it out using science data from space.
zh: 我们需要填一些表格，如果能用来自太空的科学数据填表，一定会更有趣。

en: Our science containers are all empty, and nobody wants to run out to another biome to fill one.
zh: 我们的科学容器是空的，也没人愿意到另一个生态群系将它装满。

en: We still have unchecked items on our list of records to break and would like to change that.
zh: 我们的清单上还有很多未打破的记录，是时候改变现状了。

en: Nobody has set any space records yet! It would probably be best to just start by getting something off the launchpad. Then we can start worrying about things like "survivability".
zh: 还没有人打破任何太空记录！也许最好从在发射台完成发射开始，然后再开始担心“生还可能性”这种问题。

en: The problem is that we don't actually have any idea how difficult it is to get a Kerbal to orbit, and we need to find out quickly.
zh: 问题是我们不知道把坎巴拉人送入轨道有多难，而我们需要尽快找到答案。

en: We want to know how many planets we can send a Kerbal to before they start ignoring us and fly the ship back.
zh: 我们想知道在一个坎巴拉人完全忽视我们，直接把飞船开回来之前，能让他去多少行星。

en: We're trying to assemble an interplanetary color wheel, and need someone to verify it against a few different celestial bodies.
zh: 我们在尝试组装一个行星间色环，需要有人帮我们确认几个不同天体的情况。

en: We're not saying that there are aliens on another planet in our solar system, but... aliens.
zh: 我们不是说在太阳系的其他行星中有外星人，但是…那可是外星人诶。

en: We'd like to know if getting [Topic] from somewhere other than Kerbin is as easy as taking snacks from a juvenile Kerbal.
zh: 我们想知道从Kerbin以外的地方获取[Topic]，是不是跟抢小孩子的零食一样简单。

en: We think that we can prove that there's an abundance of [Topic] throughout the solar system.
zh: 我们认为自己能证明在太阳系中有丰富的[Topic]。

en: There is very little knowledge about how the [Topic] performs under conditions not found in a standard laboratory.
zh: 对于[Topic]在标准实验室以外的环境会有什么表现，我们知之甚少。

en: The manual clearly states that the [Topic] is the best in its class. To avoid legal complications, we're going to need proof to justify our claims.
zh: 手册里明确说[Topic]是同类产品中最好的。为了避免法律纠纷，我们需要有证据证明我们的说法。

en: We have way too many parts like the [Topic], and nobody's sure how they work.
zh: 我们有太多像[Topic]这样的部件，没人知道它们该怎么用。

en: We don't actually know how to attach a [Topic] to other parts. From the bottom? The top? Is there even a way to tell which side is up?
zh: 我们不知道要怎么把[Topic]和其他部件连接。从底部？顶部？有没有区分上下的方法？

en: If we could have our flag proudly standing on the surface of [Topic], we would surely prove ourselves better than the competition.
zh: 如果我们的旗帜能在[Topic]表面高高飘扬，我们就能证明我们比竞争对手更好。

en: We want to verify that a flag planted by an astronaut is the best way to test the rigidity of the surface of [Topic].
zh: 我们想证明宇航员插的旗子是验证[Topic]表面坚硬度最好的方法。

en: We think that the aesthetic of [Topic] would be greatly improved with just one more flag, but we're not able to get one there ourselves.
zh: 我们认为再多一面旗帜后，[Topic]的美学价值将会得到大幅提升，但我们自己无法做到这一点。

en: Apparently, using crewed craft is not a good way to test theories on the dangers of space junk. If you could bring [Topic] back home, we promise not to leave anyone else up there.
zh: 显然，让载人飞行器测试太空垃圾危险性的理论是不可行的，如果你能把[Topic]带回来，我们保证不把任何人留在那里。

en: We've lost a Kerbal! Could you find [Topic] for us? Their snack supplies may be starting to run a little low.
zh: 我们失去了一名坎巴拉同胞！你能帮我们找到[Topic]吗？他的零食供应可能要不够了。

en: We've been performing a lot of experiments with leaving Kerbals in space for extended periods of time. Things were going great, until [Topic] woke up one morning and decided to walk out of their capsule.
zh: 我们做了大量将坎巴拉人长期留在太空的实验。一切进行得都很顺利，直到[Topic]在一天早上醒来，然后决定走出他的太空舱。

en: So apparently, [Topic] is having a lot of trouble with their EVA jetpack. So much so that the rest of the crew may have forgotten to wait for them to get back to the capsule, resulting in them being left in orbit.
zh: 所以显然，[Topic]的EVA喷气背包出了很多问题，以至于其他成员忘了等他回到舱内，导致其被留在轨道中。

en: We've been experimenting with methods of calculating delta-v without a Kerbal on board (a "Mechanical Bill Kerman" of sorts) and have run into some trouble. The problem being that we can't seem to get [Topic] back to Kerbin.
zh: 我们在测试当没有坎巴拉人在飞船中（某个“机械的Bill Kerman”）的情况下计算delta-v的方法，但遇到了一些问题。我们好像无法让[Topic]返回Kerbin了。

en: We've been experimenting with methods of calculating orbital information without a Kerbal on board (a "Jebediah's Engineer" of sorts) and have run into some trouble. The problem being that we can't seem to get [Topic] back to Kerbin.
zh: 我们在测试当没有坎巴拉人在飞船中（某个“Jebediah的工程师”）的情况下计算轨道信息的方法，但遇到了一些问题。我们好像无法让[Topic]返回Kerbin了。

en: We've got a competition to see which agency can get the most satellites in particular orbits, and would like some assistance.
zh: 我们在与竞争对手比赛，看谁能在给定轨道内发射最多卫星。我们正需要一些帮助。

en: We want to be a part of building some really big space stations, and the [Topic] project is a great opportunity.
zh: 我们想参与大型空间站的建造工作，而[Topic]项目就是一次很好的机会。

en: We don't know too many interesting things about [Topic], and would like to take a look around.
zh: 对于[Topic]，我们并不知道它有什么有意思的地方，因此想去那看看。

en: Some Kerbals say that every place on [Topic] looks exactly the same. We disagree, but need someome else to prove them wrong.
zh: 有些坎巴拉人说[Topic]的所有地方看上去都一模一样。我们不这么觉得，但是得有个人来证明他们的说法是错的。

en: We want to know if there are Kerbals that will really pay for the extra seats that you surely already have on your craft.
zh: 我们想知道有没有坎巴拉人会为了额外的座位掏腰包，你的飞船上肯定会有额外座位的。

en: To get to orbit, we think all we need is for a Kerbal with terrible aim to shoot for the ground and miss.
zh: 要想进入轨道，我们认为只需要找一个非常不擅长瞄准的坎巴拉人，然后让他向地面发射就好。

en: We want to know if it's as fun as it seems to be in zero-G.
zh: 我们想知道零重力是否像看上去那么有趣。

en: We aren't sure if a day on Kerbin is 6 or 24 hours long.
zh: 我们不确定在Kerbin的一天是6小时还是24小时。

en: We'd like to check if Kerbin is in fact perfectly round, and not an oblate spheroid as some lunatics suggest.
zh: 我们想看看Kerbin是不是完美球体，而不是某些疯子说的扁椭圆球体。

en: We want to know if going to the Mun is a good idea or not.
zh: 我们想知道去Mun是不是一个好主意。

en: We need to know if Mun Pies would really sell (what a time to be alive!).
zh: 我们想知道Mun派的销量会怎么样（我们生活在怎样的时代中啊！）。

en: There's no way for us to know if the surface of the Mun is as pretty as everyone thinks.
zh: 我们无法知道Mun的表面是否和大家想的一样美。

en: We want to know if Minmus is really a myth or not.
zh: 我们想知道Minmus到底是不是一个谜。

en: We're not sure how pretty Minmus is up close.
zh: 我们不知道Minmus在近距离看起来会有多美。

en: We need to know if Minmus Mint Chip ice cream would really sell.
zh: 我们想知道Minmus薄荷味冰激凌的销路会怎么样。

en: We believe that it would be a lot of fun to jump around on Minmus.
zh: 我们认为在Minmus跳上跳下一定很有趣。

en: If the surface of Minmus isn't edible, will Kerbals still try to eat it?
zh: 如果Minmus的地面不能吃，坎巴拉人还会尝试吃它吗？

en: How far does something that goes up have to go before it doesn't come down again?
zh: 一个东西需要向上飞多远，才不会掉下来？

en: We suspect that there's interesting places to see beyond Kerbin and all its moons, although we suspect there's a lot of empty space in between.
zh: 我们认为在Kerbin和其卫星之外，应该还有很多有趣的地方值得一去，但又怀疑其间会有大片啥都没有的太空。

en: Now we need your help.
zh: 现在我们需要你的帮助。

en: This is why we're here.
zh: 我们正是为此而来。

en: So this is where you come in.
zh: 这时候就需要你了。

en: We believe that you are much better positioned to deal with this than us.
zh: 我们相信你比我们更适合处理这件事。

en: So please get us an asteroid, but watch out with that claw.
zh: 请帮我们捕获一颗小行星，不过要小心那个爪子。

en: We need you to science the... Kerbal out of this.
zh: 我们需要你把这件事解释出个…绿红皂白来。

en: So if you could point some of those satellites our way, we'd be rather pleased.
zh: 如果你能把那些卫星指向我们的方向，我们会很高兴的。

en: But really, there's no sense in us still talking while there's science to be done. Shall we get to it?
zh: 不过说真的，还有科学研究要做，所以不该继续闲聊了。我们能开始了吗？

en: It's time for you to take another step in advancing the frontier.
zh: 是时候让你在推进前沿的道路上更进一步了。

en: So, when can we expect the first shipment?
zh: 那么，第一批货什么时候到？

en: So we need a few simple tests run for us.
zh: 我们需要你做几个简单的测试。

en: It would really help us out if you're able to run a test.
zh: 如果你能进行测试，那真是帮了大忙了。

en: So, up for planting a flag?
zh: 准备好插旗了吗？

en: We'd be quite grateful if you could perform this recovery operation for us.
zh: 如果你能帮我们完成这次回收行动，我们会很感激的。

en: So, can you take a few extra Kerbals with you on your next flight?
zh: 那么，下次飞行时，能多带几个坎巴拉人吗？

Magnetometer Boom
zh: 磁强计臂杆

en: Magnetic fields are all around us.  Kerbal scientists know that learning about the magnetic field of a celestial body can yield all sorts of interesting insights into what's going on inside it - but spacecraft also emit magnetic fields, especially when operating their electronics and electromechnical actuators.  And for some reason, the other engineers don't just want to turn off the entire spacecraft or build it out of plastic.  So, as a fall back position, Experimental Engineering group has stuck this sensitive magnetometer on an extensible boom.  Warning:  Warranty on the boom will be voided if you try to use it anyplace besides the vaccuum of space.
zh:
我们周围到处都是磁场。Kerbal的科学家们都知道，了解天体的磁场可让我们对其内部的情况产生各种各样有趣的见解。但航天器也会发射磁场，尤其是在操作其电子设备以及机电传动器的时候。

出于某些原因，工程师不想关闭整个航天器的动力，也不想用塑料来进行建造，因此，实验工程小组通过将此灵敏的磁强计粘贴在可伸缩的臂杆上，从而解决了这个问题。

警告：在真空空间以外的地方使用不承诺保修。

en: experiment research magnet boom
zh: 实验, 研究, 磁力, 臂杆

en: Extend Boom
zh: 伸展臂杆

en: Retract Boom
zh: 收缩臂杆

en: Run Magnetometer Report
zh: 运行磁强计报告

en: Magnetometer Report
zh: 磁强计报告

en: You've measured the interaction between the solar wind and the magnetic field of this planet as it deflects charged particles.
zh: 随着星球磁场偏转了带电粒子，你成功测量出了太阳风和该星球磁场之间的相互作用。

en: Trace magnetic fields are magnified by this sensitive instrument, and measured in real time as you orbit near this celestial body.  It's almost like hearing the heart beat of a planet, knowing if its dead inside or if something is churning.
zh: 微量磁场被这个灵敏的仪器放大，并在你绕着这个天体的轨道行进的时候进行了实时测量。这种感觉就像是听到了星球的心跳声，探得其内部到底是一片死寂，还是有什么东西在搅动。

en: Kerbin's magnetic field is weaker out here, but still easily detectable, and this instrument maps the field fluctations as they radiate into deeper space.
zh: Kerbin的磁场虽然在这里较弱，但依然很容易就探测到，而随着向更深处的地方辐射，这个仪器会绘制出磁场的波动。

en: Advanced Grabbing Unit Jr.
zh: Kerbin会对这种大小的行星产生很强的磁场，即便在这样低的轨道上也能保护我们不受太阳辐射的影响。

en: Usually, when you want to improve a part, the first thing any self-respecting Kerbal engineer thinks about is making it bigger and adding more power.  Rarely, that's not the ideal solution.  Thus was born the AGU jr.  Instead of making a bigger claw, Kerbal Motion has designed a smaller one, when you need a small helping hand to latch onto something in those hard to reach places
zh: 小型高级抓取单元

en: Intermediate Period Comet Sample
zh: 中等周期彗星样本

en: Long Period Comet Sample
zh: 长周期彗星样本

en: Interstellar Comet Sample
zh: 星际彗星样本

en: At some point in the past this comet was swung into a much tighter orbit around the Sun.  Its a good thing you got here now, it may not keep its status as a Comet for much longer wih the way the Sun is boiling off its volatile material. You've got a good scoop of this melting icecream ball to perserve and return for analysis.
zh: 在过去某个时候，这颗彗星被甩进了一条窄得多的绕日轨道中。你现在能来到这里真是太好了，随着太阳慢慢蒸发掉这颗彗星的挥发性物质，要不了多久，它或许就无法再维持彗星的形态了。你已经从这颗快要融化的冰淇淋球上舀了一大勺，回去好好分析吧。

en: This solar soujourner has been guided by Jool's massive gravity well into a periodic orbit that makes it a regular visitor to the inner system. This sample can help give our scientists a better look at what the protoplanetary disk out past Jool's orbit was composed of. Be careful bringing it back - it's a little melty.
zh: 这颗太阳漫游者在Jool庞大的引力下，被引导进入了一个周期轨道中，成为了内部星系的常客。这个样本能够帮助我们的科学家更好地了解Jool轨道外的原行星盘到底是由什么构成。请小心地将它带回来……它快化了。

en: The composition of this comet shows the unique fingerprint of the early Solar system as it has remained untouched on its long lonely journeys that only rarely bring it close to the warmth of the Sun. The smallest microscopic dust embedded into the sample you've carefully packed away contains a treasure of information for our astrogeologists.
zh: 这颗彗星的组成显示了太阳系早期的独特纹路，因其在漫长而孤独的旅途中一直保持着原貌，很少接近太阳的温暖区域。你精心包装的样本上嵌有最微小的尘埃，其中蕴含着我们天体地质学家所需要的宝贵信息。

en: You've managed to take a sample of one of the rarest pieces of celestial material - a chunk of extra-solar matter. These inter-planetary voyagers travel the space between stars, only rarely diving down into a solar gravity well. Telescopes probe the galaxy far and wide, but actually getting a piece of something from this far away is a unique achievement.
zh: 你成功获得了一块最稀有的天体物质样本之一——一块太阳系外的物质。这些星际旅行者在恒星之间旅行，很少有能潜入太阳引力井的。虽然天文望远镜能观测到遥远的星系，但真正能够获得一块从这么遥远的地方而来的碎片无疑是非常了不起的。

en: MPO Probe
zh: MPO探测器

en: The Moho Planetary Observer combines the function of many parts in one, to help make sure the searing heat of its primary mission target is distributed and dissipated without harming its critical control functionality.
zh: Moho行星观测仪将多个部件的功能结合在一起，以确保分散或消散主任务目标灼热的热量，同时不损害其关键的控制功能。

en: The Moho Transfer Module houses a control core and a generously sized xenon tank. Perfect for transporting large scientific payloads anywhere where large amounts of deltaV are required.
zh: Moho转移模块包含一个控制核心和一个大尺寸的氙气箱。非常适合在需要消耗大量DeltaV的地方运输大型科学有效载荷。
