zh: EVA科学实验

en: EVA Experiments Kit
zh: EVA实验工具

en: Probodobodyne has meticulously curated and assembled this case full of various devices and knicknacks, all of which are useful for science experiments.  Despite observations to the contrary, we feel that the inability for Kerbal astronauts to find a good use for the collapsible top hat and magic wand to be more of an issue with lack of creativity, rather than a case of items being left inside from a prior use case.
zh: 探测动力精心安排并组装了这个箱子，里面装满各种可供科学实验使用的设备。\n\n尽管观察结果与此相反，但我们认为，我们的宇航员无法好好利用折叠礼帽和魔术棒的原因主要是缺乏创造力……而非因为他们用的是二手货。

en: EVA science test kit experiment easter egg outside golf cargo
zh: 舱外活动 科学 测试 工具 实验 复活节 蛋 外部 高尔夫 货物

en: Perform EVA Science
zh: 运行EVA科学

en: Discard EVA Science Report
zh: 丢弃EVA科学报告

en: Review EVA Science Report
zh: 查看EVA科学报告

en: Watching the astronaut look through the EVA science kit has given us conclusive evidence that the new situation has not improved their creativity.
zh: 观察宇航员查看EVA科学工具让我们得出结论：新环境并没有提升他们的创造力。

en: Initial testing of off-world 0 atmosphere sporting possibility is a go - not only do the ball flight characteristics allow for some spectacular shots, but the crowd can cheer or boo as much as it wants, with no impact on the players.
zh: 对评估外星运动可行性的测试开始了——不仅足球的飞行特性使得人们能够踢出惊人的绝杀，而且目前的房地产价格还很便宜。

en: Rigorous testing of new low-temperature snack technology did not go as well as planned, and deserves further study.
zh: 对新型低温零食技术的严格测试并不如计划中顺利……还有待进一步研究。

en: Cryogenic banana experiments have proved successful, but we're still lacking EVA suit micro-airlocks to truly take advantage of your tests.
zh: 冷冻香蕉实验已获得成功，但我们始终缺少能够真正利用这些实验结果的舱外航天服微型气闸。

en: Spinning this flange in space has led to and interesting and unexpected effect - it flips orientation over and over, without any other forces acting on it.  More surprising is that our spacecraft seems to still be operating nominally while missing this part.
zh: 在太空中旋转这个轮缘后，产生了意想不到的有趣效果——在没有任何力作用在它上面时，仍然在不停地翻转。\n\n而更令人惊讶的是，我们的飞船在缺少这块部件的情况下竟然仍在继续运作。

en: Scientists say that the way this object wobbles in space is due to having three different moments of inertia in three different axes, and that this would be impossible in a four dimentional universe.  Engineers reply that it will if they can find enough four dimentional boosters.
zh: 我们的科学家称，该物体在太空中摆动的方式受到三个不同轴上的三个不同惯矩的影响，而这在四维宇宙中是不可能的事情。而工程师们则回复称，若他们能找到足够的四维助推器就可以办到。

en: Recently, we launched a rover to help us here at [Agency] explore the solar system.
zh: 最近我们发射了一辆探测车用来帮助我们在[Agency]探索太阳系。

en: Last year, [Agency] successfully landed a rover on a distant body.
zh: 去年，[Agency]在遥远的天体上使一辆探测车成功着陆。

en: It’s embarrassing to tell you this, but our shipping manifests got a little screwed up, and the rover mission we recently sent turned out to have missed a few key parts in its construction.
zh: 虽然很尴尬，但我们的货运清单真的有些混乱。在建造过程中，我们发现最近发射的探测车缺少几个关键部件。

en: Due to some unforeseen lithobraking hazards, certain parts of the rover are unfortunately no longer attached.
zh: 由于事先没有预料到降落时产生的碰撞，探测车已经丢失了某些部件。

en: The rover was designed to cover a large swath of the body - but unfortunately it’s stuck in place due to engineering oversites.
zh: 探测车的设计原本能够探测该天体的大部分区域，但不幸的是，由于工程疏误，探测车被困在了太空中。

en: This is where you come in.  We’d like you to repair the rover on site, replacing any missing pieces, and drive to the target coordinates to fulfill its original mission.
zh: 这就是我们为什么需要你。我们希望你能在现场修理探测车，换掉所有缺失部件，把它开到指定坐标，好让它完成原本的任务。

en: We’d like you to send an engineer to repair the rover.  Test drive the rover to the given coordinates to make sure it’s in good working order.
zh: 我们想要你派一名工程师来维修探测车。然后试驾探测车至指定坐标，以确保它能良好运作。

en: As the ball arcs off into the distance you observe the ballet of physics between the applied force and the bodies gravity. Our scientists will rejoice at the results...\n\n...and hopefully agree that the 6 iron was great club selecti
zh: 当球飞向远处时，你观察到在冲力与天体重力作用之下，球仿佛跳起了芭蕾。我们的科学家会为此结果感到高兴的……\n\n……也希望他们能认同6号铁是制作球杆的最佳选择。

en: You smoked that one right down the middle... I mean conducted some very effective science on the effect of lever arm force to a small spherical object.\n\nIf only Alan Kerman could see you now!
zh: 你吸了中间那根……我是说，你开展了关于“杠杆臂力对球形小物体的作用”的有效科学研究。\n\n要是Alan Kerman现在能见到你就好了！

en: Unfortunately, one of our satellites has encountered significant problems in orbit.
zh: 很不幸，我们的一枚卫星在轨道上遇到了重大问题。

en: Our comm sat has a small issue.  It’s hard to say who to blame.
zh: 我们的通信卫星出了点小问题。不太好说是谁的责任。

en: Unfortunately, despite our best efforts at [Agency], we’ve had a serious malfunction with an expensive piece of space hardware.
zh: 很不幸，尽管我们在[Agency]已经竭尽全力，但一个昂贵的太空硬件发生了严重故障。

en: The satellite is beyond our means to reach and repair it - which is where you come in.
zh: 我们无法到达、更无法维修这枚卫星——所以我们需要你。

en: Advance our knowledge of cometary bodies by discovering some new ones orbiting the Sun.
zh: 通过发现一些绕日而行的新彗星，进一步加深我们对彗星天体的认识。

en: Repair the broken component so that our asset can resume operation.
zh: 修理损坏的部件，让我们的设备能恢复运作。

en: Affect repairs on the damaged part so that the satellite can return to nominal status.
zh: 修理受损部件，让卫星恢复运行。

en: [Agency] placed a satellite in orbit some time ago, for purposes that, well, you’re not cleared to know about.
zh: [Agency]前段时间在轨道上投放了一枚卫星，目的嘛，不能告诉你。

en: A while ago, [Agency] deployed a very expensive satellite.
zh: 不久之前，[Agency]部署了一枚价格昂贵的卫星。

en: Our engineers have determined we can extend its utility if we add just one extra component.
zh: 我们的工程师已经确认，我们只需添加一个额外部件便能延长其使用期限。

en: It is nearing the end of its useful life, but we’ve determined that a small addition will be enough to extend that long enough to be worth the mission.
zh: 它的使用寿命即将耗尽，但我们已经确认，只要添加一个小部件便能延长其使用寿命，从而继续执行这项任务。

en: Attach the required part so that we don’t have to replace the one we have.
zh: 连接所需部件，我们便无需更换现有部件。

en: Send up one of your brave engineers to make the required changed and we can keep using that satellite for years to come.
zh: 派遣一名你勇敢的工程师进行必要的调整，这样那枚卫星就能再用几年了。

en: S2-33 "Clydesdale" Solid Fuel Booster
zh: S2-33“克莱兹代尔马”固体燃料助推器

en: The Clydesdale is not surprising just for its size.  It's also amazing just how much thrust comes out of this motor - nothing else in its size class comes close.
zh: “克莱兹代尔马”令人惊叹的不单是它的体积，其马达的推力也令人咋舌，这是一个让同等尺寸规模中的其他马达难以企及的水平。

en: S2-17 "Thoroughbred" Solid Fuel Booster
zh: S2-17“纯种马”固体燃料助推器

en: When Jeb asked Kerbodyne how to lift his house into space, this is what they came up with.  The Thoroughbred is a truly massive solid rocket fuel booster.  It is also the first booster Kerbodyne has managed to add thrust vector control to, adding surprising agility to this powerful motor.
zh: 当Jeb问坎巴拉动力“如何才能将他的房子抬到太空中？”时，这就是他们想出来的办法。“纯种马”是种体积庞大的固体燃料火箭助推器。这也是坎巴拉动力设法增加了推力矢量控制的第一个助推器，从而使得这款强大的马达获得了惊人的灵活性。

en: F3S0 "Shrimp" Solid Fuel Booster
zh: F3S0“虾米”固体燃料助推器

en: Kerbodyne was asked to deliver a small, high efficiency solid fuel booster and that's just what they did.  While it may just look like a someone welded a rocket nozzle onto a scuba tank, some serious technology went into making this motor.
zh: 坎巴拉动力曾被要求推出一种小型、高效的固体燃料助推器，而这就是他们的研究成果。或许它看上去像是有人把火箭喷嘴焊到了水肺潜水箱上，但是制造这种发动机时，确实用到了一些厉害的科技。

en: FM1 "Mite" Solid Fuel Booster
zh: FM1“螨虫”固体燃料助推器

en: Solid fuel boosters come in a range of sizes and this one is distinctly on the low end of the scale.  The Mite is still useful for many space programs that want a tiny kick motor to plant their probes firmly on the right trajectory, or just a bit more oomph to get their craft off the ground.
zh: 世上有各种大小的固体燃料助推器，很明显，这一款属于极精极小的那一种。当某些太空计划需要一个小型电动马达才能将探测器稳稳地安插在正确的轨道上，亦或只是为了让他们的机体更加帅气地脱离地表，“螨虫”就能派上大用场，

zh: EVA维修工具

en: While trying to solve the initial issue with the FTX-1 series fuel line, an engineer at FLOOYD Dynamics had an ingenious thought - what if you failed to attach a fuel pipe at all? en: Comets are balls of volatile materials - various ices - and dusty rock.\n\nThis comet has been brought into a much lower orbit through encounters with other celestial bodies.  It may not last much longer at the rate its ices are being depleted - at least on an astronomical timescale.  Enjoy the light show while it lasts.
zh: 彗星是由易挥发物质（各种各样的冰）和布满尘埃的岩石所组成的球体。\n\n这颗彗星因与其它天体相撞而进入了一个相对较低的轨道。按照它上面的冰的消耗速度，它可能维持不了多久了——至少还有一个天文时间尺度吧。趁它还在的时候好好欣赏这灯光秀吧。

en: Comets are balls of volatile materials - various ices - and dusty rock.\n\nA low percentage of comets get pulled into the inner system and have an apoapsis near Jool, due to the great green giant’s massive gravity well, but they seem more populous because of how often they approach the Sun  This is one of them.  Its period is such that it can be seen passing by often if tracked.
zh: 彗星是由易挥发物质（各种各样的冰）和布满尘埃的岩石所组成的球体。\n\n由于绿色巨星Jool庞大的引力井，有一小部分彗星被拉入了内部星系，并且在Jool附近有个远拱点，不过靠近太阳次数更多的彗星，其知名度也会更高些。这就是其中一颗。它的周期就是这样，如果能追踪到的话，可以经常看到它路过。

en: Comets are balls of volatile materials - various ices - and dusty rock.\n\nMany comets are thought to originate from a cloud of objects circling far outside the charted planetary bodies.  The first step in being a comet is getting perturbed into a highly elliptical orbit that enters the inner system by some unknown object.
zh: 彗星是由易挥发物质（各种各样的冰）和布满尘埃的岩石所组成的球体。\n\n许多彗星都被认为是源自于星图上注明的行星天体外围所围绕的那团物质。成为彗星的第一步就是被某个未知物体搅动而进入一个高度椭圆的轨道，从而进入内部星系。

en: Comets are balls of volatile materials - various ices - and dusty rock.\n\nThis comet’s orbit is hyperbolic with respect to the Sun.  That makes it one of the rarest objects in the system - a true interstellar traveller, destined to only visit our system once in its lonely journey.
zh: 彗星是由易挥发物质（各种各样的冰）和布满尘埃的岩石所组成的球体。\n\n这颗彗星的轨道相对于太阳来说是双曲线的。这使其成为了星系中最为稀有的天体之一——一个真正的星际旅行者，从而也注定了在其孤独的旅程中只会造访我们的星系一次。

en: Our scientists at [Agency] have been salivating over the idea of getting close-up data from a comet.  Let’s make that happen.
zh: [Agency]的科学家一直对于获取彗星近距离的数据垂涎三尺。我们赶紧将其付诸实践吧。

en: We here at [Agency] have always been interested in the might, tailed interlopers of our solar system: the Comet.
zh: [Agency]的科学家一直对于太阳系中拖着尾巴的强大闯入者——彗星有着浓厚的兴趣。

en: While we’ve done many great things here at [Agency], a mission to meet up with a comet will likely go down in history as our finest achievement.
zh: 虽然我们在[Agency]做成了许多了不起的事情，但与彗星相遇这个任务可能会作为我们最辉煌的成就而被载入历史。

en: Therefore, we need you to send a Kerbal to [Topic] to  gather a bit of comet material.  Make sure they’re extremely brave, and that they bring their helmet wipers with them, if they visit the comet while it’s near the Sun.
zh: 因此，我们需要你派一名Kerbal前去[Topic]收集一些彗星物质。请务必派遣最勇敢的人选，而且如果他们想在彗星接近太阳的时候造访它，记得让他们带上头盔雨刷。

en: You’ll need a brave astronaut to visit [Topic] and pick up a chunk of what we think will be something like the gunk you find next to the side of the road after a snowplow comes through in the winter.  Except much, much more valuable, from a scientific perspective.
zh: 你需要派遣一名勇敢的宇航员前往[Topic]，去捡一大块我们觉得像是冬天扫雪机经过后，能在路边发现的黏着物一样的东西。但从科学的角度来看，这玩意会有更大、更大的价值。

en: Conditions on the comet may be challenging.  We hope you have a Kerbal in mind who’s st… courageous enough to visit [Topic] and scoop up a chunk of it for scientific analysis.
zh: 彗星上的环境可能非常恶劣。希望你能选出最为勇敢的人选前往[Topic]，并带回来一大块物质进行科学分析。

en: Reach the comet and return or transmit a surface sample to gather valuable data about the comet.
zh: 抵达彗星并送回或传输回一份地表样本，用以收集有关彗星的珍贵数据。

en: SEQ-24 Cargo Storage Unit
zh: SEQ-24货舱存储单位

en: When you want to bring everything and the kitchen sink, this is the storage unit for you. Capable of transporting 24 different cargo items, or a small houses worth of goods and furniture. Colonize Duna in style!
zh: 如果想要携带一切，甚至是厨房的水槽，那么这款存储单元便是你的不二之选。\n\n它能够运输24种不同的货物，或是价值不菲的货物及家具。你可以按照你的风格殖民Duna！

en: contain storage cargo parts
zh: 包含货舱存储部件

en: SEQ-3C Conformal Storage Unit
zh: SEQ-3C保形存储单位

en: A small storage container, built with conformal aerodynamics in mind to allow its use on both aircraft and spacecraft. Perfect for small cargo needs, or a secret snack supply.
zh: 一款根据保形空气动力学建造的小型存储容器。飞行器与航天器均可使用。它能完美满足小型货物的存储需求，也能用来藏匿零食。

en: contain storage cargo surface conformal parts
zh: 包含货舱存储表面保形部件
